punctuated:
景泰五年進士登科錄

玉音

景泰五年二月二十八日，少傅兼太子太師、禮部尚書臣胡濙等官於奉天門奏為科舉事：會試天下舉人，取中三百五十名。本年三月初一日殿試，合請讀卷及執事等官，少傅兼太子太師、吏部尚書王直等四十七員。其進士出身等第，恭依太祖高皇帝欽定資格：第一甲例取三名，第一名從六品，第二、第三名正七品，賜進士及第；第二甲從七品，賜進士出身；第三甲正八品，賜同進士出身。奉聖旨：「是。欽此。」

讀卷官
光祿大夫、少傅兼太子太師、吏部尚書王直〔甲申進士〕
榮祿大夫、少保兼太子太傅、戶部尚書、文淵閣大學士陳循〔乙未進士〕
translation_en:
Record of Metropolitan Graduates of the Fifth Year of the Jingtai Era [1454]

Imperial Pronouncements

On the twenty-eighth day of the second month of the fifth year of the Jingtai era [March 27, 1454], Junior Tutor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and Minister of Rites Your Servant Hu Ying 胡濙 and other officials submitted a memorial at the Gate of Revering Heaven concerning the civil service examinations: In the Metropolitan Examination of provincial graduates (juren) from across the empire, 350 men have been selected as successful candidates. For the Palace Examination on the first day of the third month of this year [March 29, 1454], it is fitting to request Examination Readers and officiating officials, namely Junior Tutor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and Minister of Personnel Wang Zhi 王直 and others, forty-seven officials in all. As for the grades of qualification of the metropolitan graduates (jinshi), in reverent accordance with the qualifications imperially established by Grand Progenitor the Exalted Emperor [Taizu]: in the First Class, by precedent three men are selected, the first-placed being ranked Principal 6b and the second- and third-placed ranked Principal 7a, upon whom is conferred the designation Metropolitan Graduate with Honors (jinshi jidi); those in the Second Class are ranked Principal 7b, upon whom is conferred the designation Metropolitan Graduate (jinshi chushen); and those in the Third Class are ranked Principal 8a, upon whom is conferred the designation Associate Metropolitan Graduate (tong jinshi chushen). We received the Imperial Edict: "Approved. Respect this."

Examination Readers
Wang Zhi 王直, Grandee of the Thirty-eighth Class, Junior Tutor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of Personnel [Metropolitan Graduate of the jiashen year (1404)].
Chen Xun 陳循, Grandee of the Thirty-ninth Class, Junior Guardian concurrently Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Revenue, and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Profundity [Metropolitan Graduate of the yiwei year (1415)].

translation_en:
Sequence of Imperial Honors
Fifth Year of the Jingtai Reign (1454)
Early on the first day of the third month, the tribute scholars (gongshi) proceeded to the Inner Palace for the Palace Examination (dianshi). His Majesty took his seat in the Fengtian Hall (Hall of Revering Heaven) and personally bestowed the policy question.
Early on the third day of the third month, all civil and military officials attended in court dress, arrayed in their ranks. On this day, the Embroidered-Uniform Guard set up the imperial insignia and regalia upon the Cinnabar Stairway and within the Cinnabar Courtyard. His Majesty took his seat in the Fengtian Hall, and officials of the Court of State Ceremonial transmitted the imperial decree and called out the names of the graduates. Officials of the Ministry of Rites bore the yellow placard, led by drums and music, out past the Left Chang'an Gate, where it was posted on display. Once this was completed, officials of Shuntian Prefecture escorted the Optimus (zhuangyuan) back to his residence with parasols and ceremonial retinue.

translation_en:
On the fourth day of the third month, a banquet was bestowed at the Ministry of Rites. After the banquet concluded, they proceeded to the Court of State Ceremonial to rehearse the court rituals.
On the fifth day of the third month, the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan) was bestowed court dress, cap, and belt, and the metropolitan graduates (jinshi) were bestowed paper money (baochao).
On the sixth day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led the metropolitan graduates in submitting a memorial to express gratitude for imperial grace.
On the seventh day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led the metropolitan graduates to the Temple of the Former Teacher Confucius to perform the ritual of offering symbolic foods (shicai).
The Ministry of Rites memorialized to request that the Ministry of Works be commanded to erect a stone stele at the Directorate of Education inscribed with their names.

徐溥〔貫直隸常州府宜興縣官籍，縣學增廣生，治《書經》，字時用，行一，年二十六，七月二十一日生〕，曾祖福〔贈戶部郎中〕，祖鑑〔知府〕，父琳，母何氏。具慶下。弟濟、瀹、澍，娶杜氏。應天府鄉試第六名，會試第五十五名。

徐轄〔貫直隸常州府武進縣官籍，國子生，治《書經》，字文載，行一，年三十二，四月初一日生〕，曾祖仲廣，祖彥行，伯遵〔太醫院惠民局副使〕，父遂〔正科〕，叔述〔知縣〕，母裴氏。具慶下。弟鎬、鎔、鎧，娶高氏。應天府鄉試第二十四名，會試第二百五十八名。
translation_en:
First Class, 3 candidates: Granted the degree of Metropolitan Graduate with Honors (jinshi jidi).

Sun Xian 孫賢: Registered in a commoner household in Qi County 杞縣, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), courtesy name Shunqing 舜卿, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the first day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather is Sun Jingxian 孫敬先, his grandfather is Sun Lin 孫林, his father is Sun Xing 孫興, and his mother is née Li 李氏; both parents are living. His younger brothers are Sun Gong 孫貢 and Sun Zhi 孫質, and he is married to née Chang 常氏. He placed 21st in the Henan Provincial Examination and 113th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Pu 徐溥: Registered in an official household in Yixing County 宜興縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Zhili 直隸; an Expectant Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing), courtesy name Shiyong 時用, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-first day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Xu Fu 徐福 (posthumously honored as Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue), his grandfather is Xu Jian 徐鑑 (Prefect), his father is Xu Lin 徐琳, and his mother is née He 何氏; both parents are living. His younger brothers are Xu Ji 徐濟, Xu Yue 徐瀹, and Xu Shu 徐澍, and he is married to née Du 杜氏. He placed 6th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 55th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Xia 徐轄: Registered in an official household in Wujin County 武進縣, Changzhou Prefecture, Zhili; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing), courtesy name Wenzai 文載, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the first day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather is Xu Zhongguang 徐仲廣, his grandfather is Xu Yanhang 徐彥行, his paternal elder uncle is Xu Zun 徐遵 (Vice Commissioner of the Charitable Pharmacy in the Imperial Academy of Medicine), his father is Xu Sui 徐遂 (Prefectural Physician), his paternal younger uncle is Xu Shu 徐述 (District Magistrate), and his mother is née Pei 裴氏; both parents are living. His younger brothers are Xu Hao 徐鎬, Xu Rong 徐鎔, and Xu Kai 徐鎧, and he is married to née Gao 高氏. He placed 24th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 258th in the Metropolitan Examination.

王鉉〔貫浙江杭州府臨安縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字廷器，行二，年三十五，三月十八日生〕。曾祖思善；祖銓；父瑾；母童氏。具慶下，兄鎮，弟鑫、鑑、鏓、鑌，娶程氏。浙江鄉試第五十八名，會試第四十二名。
translation_en:
Hu Rong 胡榮 [registered in a military household in Xinyu County, Linjiang Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Xiren; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty, born on the tenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Hu Zigu; his grandfather was Hu Yuanyuan; his father was Hu Chunqi; and his mother was Lady Song. Both parents are living; he has a younger brother, Hu Dao; and he is married to Lady Ruan. He placed seventeenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and three hundred forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Lin 陳琳 [registered in an official household in Yingcheng County, De'an Prefecture, Huguang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Wenbi; fourth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-two, born on the seventeenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Chaoyu [District Magistrate]; his grandfather was Chen Zhifang [Instructor, posthumously honored as Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice]; his father was Chen Tan [Prefect]; and his mother was Lady Xu [invested as Lady of Suitability (Yiren)]. Both parents are living; he has elder brothers Chen Xuan, Chen Ji, and Chen Ying, and younger brothers Chen Jing and Chen Zhang; and he is married to Lady Guo. He placed sixty-third in the Huguang Provincial Examination and two hundred second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Kang Lin 康麟 [registered in a civilian household in Shunde County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Wenrui; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-six, born on the eighteenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Kang Zhike; his grandfather was Kang Shuide; his father was Kang Miaoguan; and his mother was Lady Cui. Both parents are living; he has younger brothers Kang Feng, Kang Kui, and Kang Long; and he is married to Lady Cui. He placed third in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Xuan 王鉉 [registered in a civilian household in Lin'an County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Tingqi; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-five, born on the eighteenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Sishan; his grandfather was Wang Quan; his father was Wang Jin; and his mother was Lady Tong. Both parents are living; he has an elder brother, Wang Zhen, and younger brothers Wang Xin, Wang Jian, Wang Cong, and Wang Bin; and he is married to Lady Cheng. He placed fifty-eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and forty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Huang Jin 黃謹 (registered as of civilian status in Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建; a County School Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Tingyi 廷儀, fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the seventeenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Jingxuan 靜軒; his grandfather was Zecheng 則誠; his father was Huan 宦 (Prefectural Director of Studies); and his mother is née Zheng 鄭. His mother is living and his father is deceased (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Yu 諭, Yu 譽 (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner in the Zhejiang Surveillance Commission), and Liang 諒; his younger brother is Xun 詢. He married Lady Gao 高. He placed second in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 104th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xie Shou 謝綬 (registered as of official status in Le'an County 樂安縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 撫州府, Jiangxi 江西; an Added Student of the County School specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Weizhang 維章, fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-one, born on the nineteenth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Boshun 伯順; his grandfather was Yongzhao 永昭 (posthumously honoured as Director of the Bureau of Evaluations in the Ministry of Personnel); his father is Fu 輔 (Left Administration Vice Commissioner in the Zhejiang Provincial Administration Commission); and his mother is née Yu 余 (invested as Lady of Suitability). Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqing xia). His elder brothers are Hong 紘 (Assistant Instructor), Shao 紹, and [? Rp]; his younger brothers are Shen 紳 and Qi 緝. He married Lady Jiang 姜. He placed 106th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 259th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Qing 李清 (registered as of military status in Shanghai County 上海縣, Songjiang Prefecture 松江府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); an Added Student of the County School specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Xixian 希獻, second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-one, born on the sixteenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Yuanfang 原芳; his grandfather was Gong 珙; his father is Boyu 伯璵 (County Director of Studies); his mother was née Lu 陸, and his stepmother is née Ni 倪. Both his father and stepmother are living (juqing xia). His elder brother is Cheng 澄; his younger brothers are Qian 潛, Zhan 湛, Jun 浚, Ze 澤, and Lan 瀾. He married Lady He 何. He placed 122nd in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 295th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Chaoyuan 王朝遠 (registered as of civilian status in Jinxian County 進賢縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西; an Added Student of the Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Chaoyuan 朝遠, fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-two, born on the twenty-sixth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Weirong 惟榮; his grandfather is Boning 伯寧; his father is Mengcheng 孟成; his mother was née Tu 涂, and his stepmother is née Wan 萬. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqing xia). His elder brother is Chaoyang 朝陽, and his younger brother is Chaogui 朝貴. [4 illegible characters; likely marriage record]. He placed seventy-third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and [6 illegible characters; Metropolitan Examination rank]th.

高宗本〔貫直隸保定府雄縣軍籍，鎭海太倉衛學軍生，治《易經》，字茂卿，行一，年三十五，六月十六日生〕。曾祖彥溫；祖良佐；父以仁；嫡母范氏，繼母張氏，生母嚴氏。慈侍下。弟宗立。娶倪氏。應天府鄉試第三十五名，會試第三百六名。

孔公恂〔貫山東兗州府曲阜縣儒籍，國子生，宣聖五十八世孫，治《禮記》，字宗文，行一，年二十九，四月二十五日生〕。曾祖克全〔元教授〕；祖士亨；父志伯〔貢士〕；母王氏。嚴侍下。弟公錫〔庚午貢士〕、公忱、公忭。娶蔡氏，繼娶余氏。山東鄉試第二十九名，會試第二百四十二名。

史瑾〔貫直隸淮安府山陽縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字德輝，行一，年三十二，正月十一日生〕。曾祖彥中；伯祖善聞〔陝西布政司參議〕；祖叔謙；父存澤；母朱氏。重慶下。弟瓛、瓚、琳。娶李氏，繼娶趙氏。應天府鄉試第三十名，會試第一百二十八名。
translation_en:
Gao Zongben 高宗本 (registered under a military household in Xiong County, Baoding Prefecture, Zhili; a Military Student in the guard school of Zhenhai and Taicang Guards; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Maoqing; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-five, born on the sixteenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Yanwen; his grandfather was Liangzuo; his father was Yiren; his legal mother was née Fan, his stepmother was née Zhang, and his birth mother is née Yan. His mother is living. His younger brother is Zongli. He married née Ni. He placed thirty-fifth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and three hundred and sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Duan 嚴端 (registered as a supernumerary soldier in the Rear Battalion of Ningbo Guard under the Zhejiang Regional Military Commission; a Military Student in the Ningbo Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Kezheng; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-six, born on the sixteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Jing; his grandfather was Deshan; his father is Su; and his mother is née Yue. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Zhuang. He married née Song. He placed fifty-fourth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and three hundred and fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Kong Gongxun 孔公恂 (registered under a Confucian scholar household in Qufu County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a Student of the Directorate of Education; a fifty-eighth-generation descendant of the Exalted Sage [Confucius]; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Zongwen; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fifth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Kequan (a Yuan-dynasty Instructor); his grandfather was Shiheng; his father is Zhibo (a Tribute Student); and his mother was née Wang. His father is living. His younger brothers are Gongxi (a Tribute Student of the gengwu year [1450]), Gongchen, and Gongbian. He married née Cai, and subsequently married née Yu. He placed twenty-ninth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred and forty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shi Jin 史瑾 (registered under a civilian household in Shanyang County, Huai'an Prefecture, Zhili; a Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Dehui; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-two, born on the eleventh day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Yanzhong; his grand-uncle was Shanwen (an Administration Vice Commissioner of the Shaanxi Provincial Administration Commission); his grandfather is Shuqian; his father is Cunze; and his mother is née Zhu. Both his grandparents and his parents are living. His younger brothers are Huan, Zan, and Lin. He married née Li, and subsequently married née Zhao. He placed thirtieth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred and twenty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

張寧〔貫浙江湖州府德清縣軍籍，嘉興府海鹽縣學增廣生，治《書經》，字靖之，行一，年二十九，十一月三十日生〕。曾祖仲山；祖文俊；父翥，母丁氏。具慶下，弟寬。娶唐氏，繼娶王氏。浙江鄉試第十一名，會試第七名。

耿裕〔貫河南河南府盧氏縣官籍，山西平定州人，儒士，治《書經》，字好問，行六，年二十五，二月十六日生〕。曾祖承祖〔前太常寺太祝，贈刑部右侍郎〕；祖綱〔教諭，累贈刑部右侍郎〕；父九疇〔都察院右副都御史〕，母高氏〔封淑人〕。具慶下，兄聰、睿、智、寬，弟溫、發。娶鄭氏。順天府鄉試第六十五名，會試第一百二十五名。

徐鑾〔貫浙江衢州府開化縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字用和，行十一，年三十二，六月初二日生〕。曾祖周士；祖伯昌；父曦〔伴讀〕，嫡母韓氏，母李氏。慈侍下，兄英。娶許氏。浙江鄉試第二十七名，會試第三名。

劉洪〔貫浙江寧波府定海縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字文裕，行十六，年二十六，八月十三日生〕。曾祖豫〔元廉訪副使〕；祖廷毅；父時和，前母莊氏，母陳氏。具慶下，兄清、濟、淮、海。娶周氏。浙江鄉試第四十二名，會試第三百一名。
translation_en:
Zhang Ning 張寧 [registered in a military household of Deqing County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; Additional Student of the Haiyan County School in Jiaxing Prefecture; specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Jingzhi; first in his generation; age twenty-nine, born on the thirtieth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Zhongshan, his grandfather Zhang Wenjun, his father Zhang Zhu, and his mother Lady Ding. Both parents are living; his younger brother is Zhang Kuan. He married Lady Tang, and after her death married Lady Wang. He ranked 11th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 7th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Geng Yu 耿裕 [registered in an official household of Lushi County, Henan Prefecture, Henan; a native of Pingding Subprefecture, Shanxi; a Confucian scholar (rushi); specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Haowen; sixth in his generation; age twenty-five, born on the sixteenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Geng Chengzu [formerly a Great Invocationer in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, posthumously granted the title of Right Vice Minister of Justice], his grandfather Geng Gang [Instructor, successively granted the posthumous title of Right Vice Minister of Justice], his father Geng Jiuchou [Right Vice Censor-in-Chief in the Censorate], and his mother Lady Gao [invested as a Lady of Virtue]. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Geng Cong, Geng Rui, Geng Zhi, and Geng Kuan, and his younger brothers are Geng Wen and Geng Fa. He married Lady Zheng. He ranked 65th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 125th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Luan 徐鑾 [registered in a civilian household of Kaihua County, Quzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; County School Student; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yonghe; eleventh in his generation; age thirty-two, born on the second day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Zhoushi, his grandfather Xu Bochang, his father Xu Xi [Companion for the Heir Apparent's Reading], his legal mother Lady Han, and his birth mother Lady Li. His mother is living; his elder brother is Xu Ying. He married Lady Xu. He ranked 27th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 3rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Hong 劉洪 [registered in a military household of Dinghai County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; Student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wenyu; sixteenth in his generation; age twenty-six, born on the thirteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Yu [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner in the Yuan dynasty], his grandfather Liu Tingyi, his father Liu Shihe, his father's former wife Lady Zhuang, and his mother Lady Chen. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Liu Qing, Liu Ji, Liu Huai, and Liu Hai. He married Lady Zhou. He ranked 42nd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 301st in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
孫輝〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣軍籍，縣學增廣生，治《禮記》，字德昭，行四，年二十五，九月十七日生〕。曾祖岳，祖子高，父相，母陳氏。重慶下。弟耀、燿、炫。娶魯氏。浙江鄉試第二十四名，會試第一百六名。

彭華〔貫江西吉安府安福縣儒籍，縣學增廣生，治《春秋》，字彥實，行十四，年二十三，十一月初十日生〕。曾祖伯樞，祖同升〔贈刑部主事〕，父貫〔浙江按察司僉事〕，母伍氏〔封安人〕。具慶下。兄𢘆、洪、善亹、彥充、亹，弟禮。娶劉氏。江西鄉試第七名，會試第一名。

劉釪〔貫江西吉安府安福縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《春秋》，字伏和，行五，年三十三，十一月二十六日生〕。曾祖子定，祖伯文〔贈禮部主事〕，父球〔侍講，贈翰林學士，謚忠愍〕，母鄧氏〔封太宜人〕。慈侍下。叔玭〔刑部主事〕，兄鉞〔中書舍人兼正字〕、銳〔訓導〕，弟鎰〔貢士〕。娶伍氏。江西鄉試第二名，會試第三百四十二名。

陳龍〔貫江西吉安府泰和縣儒籍，縣學增廣生，治《詩經》，字元亮，行五，年三十七，三月二十三日生〕。曾祖有慶，伯祖仲述〔監察御史〕，祖仲亨，伯餘慶，父直〔按察司照磨〕，母嚴氏。嚴侍下。兄奐〔教諭〕、獎。娶蕭氏，繼娶蕭氏。江西鄉試第二十名，會試第四十名。
translation_en:
Sun Hui 孫輝 (registered in a military household in Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Added Student at the County School; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Dezhao; fourth in seniority; aged twenty-five, born on the seventeenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Sun Yue; his grandfather was Sun Zigao; his father is Sun Xiang; his mother is Lady Chen. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Sun Yao, Sun Yao, and Sun Xuan. He married Lady Lu. He placed twenty-fourth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Peng Hua 彭華 (registered in a Confucian scholar household in Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Added Student at the County School; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Yanshi; fourteenth in seniority; aged twenty-three, born on the tenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Peng Boshu; his grandfather was Peng Tongsheng (posthumously awarded the title of Secretary in the Ministry of Justice); his father is Peng Guan (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner of Zhejiang); his mother is Lady Wu (invested as Mistress of Peace). Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Peng Heng, Peng Hong, Peng Shanwei [?], Peng Yanchong, and Peng Wei [?]; his younger brother is Peng Li. He married Lady Liu. He placed seventh in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Yu 劉釪 (registered in a commoner household in Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Added Student at the County School; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Fuhe; fifth in seniority; aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-sixth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Liu Ziding; his grandfather was Liu Bowen (posthumously awarded the title of Secretary in the Ministry of Rites); his father was Liu Qiu (Expositor-in-waiting, posthumously awarded the title of Hanlin Academician, canonized as Zhongmin); his mother is Lady Deng (invested as Grand Mistress of Suitability). His mother is living. His paternal uncle is Liu Pin (Secretary in the Ministry of Justice); his elder brothers are Liu Yue (Drafter in the Central Drafting Office concurrently serving as Corrector of Characters) and Liu Rui (Assistant Instructor); his younger brother is Liu Yi (Tribute Scholar). He married Lady Wu. He placed second in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and three hundred and forty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Long 陳龍 (registered in a Confucian scholar household in Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Added Student at the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Yuanliang; fifth in seniority; aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-third day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Chen Youqing; his paternal grand-uncle was Chen Zhongshu (Investigating Censor); his grandfather was Chen Zhongheng; his paternal uncle was Chen Yuqing; his father is Chen Zhi (Record Keeper in a Provincial Surveillance Commission); his mother was Lady Yan. His father is living. His elder brothers are Chen Huan (Instructor) and Chen Jiang. He married Lady Xiao, and after her death married another Lady Xiao. He placed twentieth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
杜宥〔貫直隸常州府江陰縣，民籍。國子生，治《易經》。字叔寛，行一，年四十，正月十五日生〕。曾祖玉泉；祖隰〔禮科給事中〕；父政；母包氏。永感下。弟完、密。娶徐氏。應天府鄉試第十七名，會試第四十一名。

張畹〔貫直隸松江府華亭縣，民籍。國子生，治《詩經》。字茂蘭，行五，年三十五，九月二十日生〕。曾祖國祥；祖宗武〔主簿〕；父廷嵩；母顧氏。慈侍下。兄疇、畦、紹、畋、瞵；弟畊、畿。娶周氏。應天府鄉試第一百五十六名，會試第二百三十四名。

黃隆〔貫浙江寧波府鄞縣，民籍。府學生，治《禮記》。字自立，行四，年三十，正月十九日生〕。曾祖景禎；祖良〔贈監察御史〕；父潤玉〔知縣〕；母范氏〔封孺人〕；繼母舒氏。具慶下。兄性〔訓導〕、教、道；弟達。娶王氏。浙江鄉試第十名，會試第五十二名。

張黼〔貫江西臨江府新喻縣，官籍。縣學生，治《春秋》。字良甫，行一，年三十六，五月二十八日生〕。曾祖允恭；祖懷立〔禮科給事中，贈太常寺少卿〕；父固〔大理寺右少卿〕；母黃氏〔贈恭人〕；繼母孫氏。具慶下。弟載、戢、扆、寀、大通。娶錢氏，繼娶朱氏。江西鄉試第七十二名，會試第一百十四名。
translation_en:
Du You 杜宥 [registered as a commoner of Jiangyin County, Changzhou Prefecture, in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a student in the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng), specializing in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shukuan, first in seniority among his brothers, aged forty, born on the fifteenth day of the first lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Yuquan; his grandfather was Xi [Supervising Secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Rites]; his father was Zheng; and his mother was née Bao. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Wan and Mi. He married a woman née Xu. He placed 17th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 41st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Wan 張畹 [registered as a commoner of Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, in the Metropolitan Area; a student in the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Maolan, fifth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the twentieth day of the ninth lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Guoxiang; his grandfather was Zongwu [Assistant Magistrate]; his father was Tingsong; and his mother is née Gu. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Chou, Qi, Shao, Tian, and Lin; his younger brothers are Geng and Ji. He married a woman née Zhou. He placed 156th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 234th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Long 黃隆 [registered as a commoner of Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; a prefectural school student, specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zili, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the nineteenth day of the first lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Jingzhen; his grandfather was Liang [posthumously honored as Investigating Censor]; his father is Runyu [District Magistrate]; his mother was née Fan [invested as Child-Nurturess (ruren)]; and his stepmother is née Shu. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Xing [Assistant Instructor], Jiao, and Dao; his younger brother is Da. He married a woman née Wang. He placed 10th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 52nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Fu 張黼 [registered under an official household of Xinyu County, Linjiang Prefecture, Jiangxi; a county school student, specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Liangfu, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-eighth day of the fifth lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Yungong; his grandfather was Huaili [Supervising Secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Rites, posthumously honored as Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices]; his father is Gu [Right Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review]; his mother was née Huang [posthumously honored as Reverent Lady (gongren)]; and his stepmother is née Sun. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brothers are Zai, Ji, Yi, Cai, and Datong. He married a woman née Qian, and remarried a woman née Zhu. He placed 72nd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 114th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Zhi 盧秩: Registered in a civilian household of Xingan County, Linjiang Prefecture, Jiangxi; a Directorate Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His courtesy name is Chongxu, he is the seventh in his generation, and he is forty-four years old, born on the fifteenth day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Zhiren, his grandfather was Shaoxian, his father was Yuyi, his mother was Madam Zhan, and his stepmother is Madam Liao [Liao 廖?]. His mother/stepmother is living. His elder brothers are Chonglun and Chongji, and his younger brothers are Chongyue and Chongbin. He is married to Madam Yan. He placed sixth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and three hundred and fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zeng Hui 曾會: Registered in a civilian household of Yanshan County, Hejian Prefecture, Directly Attached region (Zhili); a County Student (xianxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His courtesy name is Yiwen, he is the first in his generation, and he is twenty-seven years old, born on the sixteenth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Zhongxiang (Assistant Salt Distribution Commissioner), his grandfather is Youzheng (Prefect), his father is Renzhong, and his mother is Madam Zhang. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers (or cousins) are Lu, Shun, and Guan, and his younger brothers are Fu, Que, and Cheng. He is married to Madam Li. He placed sixtieth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and ninety-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pu Yong 浦鏞: Registered in a civilian household of Shangyuan County, Yingtian Prefecture, and a native of Changzhou County, Directly Attached region (Zhili); a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Changes. His courtesy name is Tingyong, he is the first in his generation, and he is thirty-six years old, born on the twenty-eighth day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Shiming, his grandfather was Shuyuan, his father is Hao, his father's former wife was Madam Jiang, and his mother is Madam Mao. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Tang, Jian, Hao, and Jin. He was married to Madam Zhou and remarried to Madam Ni. He placed one hundred and ninety-fifth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and two hundred and forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Lun 朱倫: Registered in an official household of Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Directly Attached region (Zhili); a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Documents. His courtesy name is Diyi, he is the sixth in his generation, and he is thirty-three years old, born on the eleventh day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Su (Prefectural Judge under the Yuan), his grandfather was Youzhi (Prefectural Administrative Clerk, posthumously honored as Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of War), his paternal uncle was Zongwen (Department Magistrate), his father was Xin (Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Works), and his mother was Madam Tao (invested as Lady of Suitability). Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Diji, Dizhe (Vice County Magistrate), Dide, Dijian, and Dishan. He is married to Madam Lu. He placed forty-fourth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred and eighty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

苗灝〔貫山東濟南府德州軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字勢遠，行二，年二十八，八月二十九日生〕。曾祖秀實；祖復禮〔刑部員外郎〕；父端；母楊氏。具慶下。兄志遠，弟源、溱、深、溥、瀾、澍。娶顧氏。山東鄉試第十五名，會試第二百四名。

魏銘〔貫湖廣武昌府蒲圻縣軍籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字日新，行二，年二十七，十一月初九日生〕。曾祖觀〔祭酒〕；祖子栗；父思廣；母侯氏。具慶下。兄鑑。娶黃氏。湖廣鄉試第一百七名，會試第一百八十三名。
translation_en:
Li Yongming 黎永明 (registered in a military household of Jingshan County, Anlu Subprefecture, Huguang; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Guangheng; third in his generation; age twenty-seven, born on the twenty-seventh day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Xingfu, his grandfather was Tianshou, his father is Zan, and his mother is née Tian. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Yongchang, Yongxuan, and Yongfang, and his younger brothers are Yongji and Yongxiao. He married née Yang. He ranked 7th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 21st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Ben 閻本 (registered in an artisan household of Bin Subprefecture, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); style name Zongyuan; second in his generation; age thirty, born on the eleventh day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Junqing, his grandfather was De, his father is Shen, and his mother is née Lu. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Ju. He married née Lü. He ranked 40th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 115th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Miao Hao 苗灝 (registered in a military household of De Subprefecture, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry; style name Shiyuan; second in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Xiushi, his grandfather was Fuli (Vice Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Justice), his father is Duan, and his mother is née Yang. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Zhiyuan, and his younger brothers are Yuan, Zhen, Shen, Pu, Lan, and Shu. He married née Gu. He ranked 15th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 204th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wei Ming 魏銘 (registered in a military household of Puqi County, Wuchang Prefecture, Huguang; a student of the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry; style name Rixin; second in his generation; age twenty-seven, born on the ninth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Guan (Chancellor of the Directorate of Education), his grandfather was Zili, his father is Siguang, and his mother is née Hou. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Jian. He married née Huang. He ranked 107th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 183rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Cheng Jian 程鑑 [registered in a civilian household of Kaizhou 開州 in Daming Prefecture 大名府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); a National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Kongzhao 孔昭; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the fourteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Cheng Dalao 大老; his grandfather was Cheng Zhongqian 仲謙; his father is Cheng Yi 義 [Assistant Prefect (tongpan)]; his father's former wife was née Hu 胡氏, his mother was née Song 宋氏, and his stepmother is née Zhang 張氏. His father is living. His elder brother is Cheng Yong 鏞, and his younger brothers are Cheng Duo 鐸, Cheng Zhong 鍾, Cheng Fu 鈇, and Cheng Yue 鉞. He married née Ji 紀氏. He placed eleventh in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Gu 王穀 [registered in a military household of Nanxi County 南溪縣 in Xuzhou Prefecture 敘州府, Sichuan 四川; an Added Student (zengguangsheng) of the County School; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Wanshi 萬石; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the ninth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Wenxin 文信; his grandfather was Wang Yong 永 [Secretary of a Bureau (zhushi)]; his father is Wang Yan 宴; and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Wang Su 粟, Wang Fu 符, Wang Jie 節, Wang Ji 稷, and Wang Shu 菽. He married née Jian 簡氏. He placed tenth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ou Lian 歐廉 [registered in a civilian household of Meizhou 眉州, Sichuan 四川; a National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shijie 仕潔; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged forty, born on the twenty-first day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Ou Zusan 祖三; his grandfather was Ou Junxiang 均祥; his father was Ou Chou 儔; his father's former wife was née Jin 金氏, and his mother is née Fei 費氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Ou Zhihai 志海, Ou Zhiman 志滿, Ou Zhimin 志敏, and Ou Haishan 海善. He married née Yang 楊氏. He placed twenty-fifth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and three hundred thirty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Fu 蔣紱 [registered in a military household of Changshu County 常熟縣 in Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); a National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Hongzhang 洪章; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the fourteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Jiang Daohua 道華; his grandfather was Jiang An 安; his father is Jiang Ying 瑛; and his mother is née Xu 許氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Jiang Jie 結, and his younger brothers are Jiang Zu 組, Jiang Ji 績, Jiang Xu 續, and Jiang Qi 綺. He married née Zhang 張氏, and took née Zhou 周氏 as his second wife. He placed eleventh in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Song Rong 宋榮 [registered in a civilian household of Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; Added Student at the county school; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Hongren; fifth in seniority; aged thirty-five, born on the seventh day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Song Junxiang, his grandfather was Song Yide, his father was Song Zicheng [Righteous Commoner], and his mother is Madam Luo. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Song Hongji, Song Hongyi [Righteous Commoner with Cap and Belt], Song Hongyuan, and Song Hongdao, and he is married to Madam Yu. He placed one hundred forty-eighth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and three hundred eighteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fan Yong 范鏞 [registered in a civilian household of Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yansheng; fourth in seniority; aged thirty-three, born on the fifth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Fan Kongjing, his grandfather was Fan Gui [Assistant Magistrate, enfeoffed as District Magistrate], his father is Fan Zhong [metropolitan graduate (jinshi), serving as District Magistrate], and his mother is Madam Nie [enfeoffed as Child Nurturer]. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Fan Yi, Fan Jian, and Fan Duo; his younger brothers are Fan Zhen, Fan Ding, Fan Ying, Fan Rui, Fan Ming, Fan Hao, and Fan Qin; and he is married to Madam Chen. He placed sixty-third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Jian 許間 [registered in a civilian household of Chun'an County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Hezhong; ninth in seniority; aged thirty-four, born on the fourteenth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Zhongwen, his grandfather was Xu Shiyao [? 𠎝], his father is Xu Yongxiao, and his mother was Madam Xiang. His father is living. His elder brothers are Xu Xunzhong and Xu Meizhong; his younger brothers are Xu Mizhong and Xu Xuanzhong; and he is married to Madam Fang. He placed fifty-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and three hundred twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Jiao Xian 焦顯 (registered under a military household in Dezhou 德州, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong 山東; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Wenming 文明; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-third day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Jiao Yi 義; his grandfather was Jiao Fushan 復善; his father is Jiao Sheng 勝; and his mother is née Guo 郭氏. Both of his parents are living. He has a younger brother, Yong 顒, and is married to a woman née Li 李氏. He placed ninety-fifth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Du Qian 杜謙 (registered under a civilian household in Changli County 昌黎縣, Yongping Prefecture 永平府, Zhili 直隸; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Yizhi 益之; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the twelfth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Du Yanwen 彥文; his grandfather was Du Fuzu 復祖; his father is Du Min 敏; his father's former wife was née Yang 楊氏; his birth mother was née Wang 王氏; and his stepmother is née Dong 董氏. His father is living. He has elder brothers Gong 恭 and Sheng 昇, and is married to a woman née Yang 楊氏. He placed seventy-seventh in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and twenty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qu Quan 屈銓 (registered under a civilian household in Lucheng County 潞城縣, Luzhou 潞州, Shanxi 山西; an Added Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Tianheng 天衡; fifth in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the thirteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Qu Wenzhong 文忠; his grandfather was Qu Jingzong 敬宗; his father is Qu Yin 禋 (Instructor); and his mother is née Sun 孫氏. Both of his parents are living. He has elder brothers Jian 鑑, Ming 銘, Qian 鉛, and Rong 鎔, and is married to a woman née Shen 申氏. He placed first in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Shirang 林時讓 (registered under a civilian household in Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建; a Confucian Scholar specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Chunli 純禮; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the nineteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Lin Ji 季 (Gentleman for Managing Affairs); his grandfather was Lin Daochuan 道傳; his father is Lin Jin 津 (Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue); his birth mother was née Huang 黃氏; and his stepmother is née Chen 陳氏. His father and stepmother are both living. He has an elder brother, Shihou 時厚, and younger brothers, Shigong 時恭 and Shiqian 時謙; he married a woman née Song 宋氏 and remarried a woman née Wang 王氏. He placed fifty-fifth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Wu Zhen 吳禎 (registered in a military household of the Embroidered-uniform Guard [Jinyi wei], a native of Qianshan County in the Metropolitan Area [Zhili], a translator [yizi], specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing], courtesy name Congshan, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Wu Xing, his grandfather was Wu Shou, his father was Wu Zhongxian, and his mother is née Wang. His mother is living. He has an elder brother, Wu Bin, and a younger brother, Wu Xiang; he is married to née Tang. He placed seventy-third in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and one hundred eightieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Qiaoxin 何喬新 (registered in an official household of Guangchang County, Jianchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, a National University Student [guozi sheng], specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing], courtesy name Tingxiu, third in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-sixth day of the intercalary fourth month). His great-grandfather was He Deyuan (posthumously honoured as Left Vice Minister of Personnel), his grandfather was He Jingrong (posthumously honoured as Left Vice Minister of Personnel), his father is He Wenyuan (Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent concurrently serving as Minister of Personnel), and his mother is née Jie (invested as Mistress of Virtue [shuren]). Both his parents are living. He has elder brothers He Benmao and He Benqian, and younger brothers He Qiaoshou, He Qiaofu, and He Qiaonian; he is married to née Wu. He placed sixth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhuang Jing 莊敬 (registered in a commoner household of Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, a National University Student [guozi sheng], specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing], courtesy name Kecheng, fifth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the twentieth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Zhuang Qizhong, his grandfather was Zhuang Benran, his father is Zhuang Jing, and his mother is née Tang. Both his parents are living. He has younger brothers Zhuang Min, Zhuang Zheng, and Zhuang Yu; he is married to née Chen. He placed seventy-third in the Fujian Provincial Examination and thirty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Neng 魯能 (registered in a military household of the Xinhui Independent Battalion [shouyu qianhu suo], Guangdong, a National University Student [guozi sheng], specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing], courtesy name Qianzhi, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the second day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Lu Tongbao, his grandfather was Lu Baoyi, his father is Lu Zhen, and his mother is née Zhou. Both his parents are living. He has an elder brother, Lu Xian, and younger brothers Lu Ying, Lu Jun, Lu Xiu, and Lu Jie; he is married to née Luo. He placed sixty-seventh in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Chen Xuan 陳瑄 (registered in a military household in Meizhou 眉州, Sichuan; a Subprefectural Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Tingxian 廷獻; first in generational seniority; aged thirty-three, born on the twentieth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Rende 仁德, his grandfather was Chen Wenfu 文富, his father is Chen Tianlu 添祿, and his mother was Madam Yang 楊氏. His father is living and his mother is deceased. He is married to Madam Liu 劉氏. He ranked forty-first in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Wei 楊緯 (registered in a civilian household in Taihe County 太和縣, Dali Prefecture 大理府, Yunnan; an Added Student of the County School specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); style name Zongwu 宗武; fourth in generational seniority; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-ninth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Yang Huai 懷, his grandfather was Yang She 赦, his father is Yang Ziyuan 子淵 (Assistant Instructor), and his mother is Madam Li 李氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Yang Jin 縉, Yang Shen 紳 (Tribute Student), and Yang Jing 經 (Tribute Student); his younger brothers are Yang Yi 繹, Yang Ji 紀, and Yang Su 素. He is unmarried. He ranked fifth in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Qing 蕭青 (a supernumerary soldier registered in the Huizhou Guard 惠州衛, Guangdong; an Added Student of the Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Tingcui 廷翠; first in generational seniority; aged twenty-seven, born on the sixteenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Xiao Huashu 華淑, his grandfather was Xiao Wenming 文明, his father was Xiao Wang 旺, and his mother was Madam Liu 劉氏. Both of his parents are deceased. He married Madam Liu 劉氏, and took Madam Song 宋氏 as his second wife. He ranked twenty-fourth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and one hundred twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zeng Wei 曾唯 (registered in a civilian household in Luling County 廬陵縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi; a County Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Ziyi 子一; second in generational seniority; aged forty, born on the seventeenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Zeng Rulu 如魯, his grandfather was Zeng Zhongqi 仲奇, his father was Zeng Yi 沂, and his mother was Madam Liu 劉氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Zeng Zixing 子省. He is married to Madam Ouyang 歐陽氏. He ranked one hundred fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
陳雲鶚〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《禮記》，字翔之，行七，年二十九，七月十七日生〕。曾祖惟一；祖肅初；父濃〔封大理寺評事〕；前母洪氏〔贈安人〕；母吳氏〔封安人〕。具慶下。兄雲鵬〔山東布政司參議〕、雲翰；弟雲鳳。娶陸氏。浙江鄉試第三十七名，會試第一百八十七名。

趙文博〔貫山西太原府代州軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字守約，行二，年三十，十月十五日生〕。曾祖子齊；祖思銘；父中〔知縣〕；母張氏。永感下。兄文陞；弟文進。娶白氏。山西鄉試第五十六名，會試第五十名。

王衡〔貫福建福州府閩縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字文瞻，行一，年三十九，十二月二十八日生〕。曾祖廣濟；祖志崇；父穆；母陳氏。具慶下。弟璣、珖。娶林氏。福建鄉試第五十四名，會試第二百五十五名。

邵銅〔貫福建福州府閩縣軍籍，府學增廣生，治《詩經》，字振聲，行三，年四十三，十二月二十日生〕。曾祖宗美〔元閩良官〕；祖烺；父垣；母葉氏。永感下。弟鏐、鈍〔聽選官〕。娶陳氏，繼娶陳氏。福建鄉試第二名，會試第一百七十四名。
translation_en:
Chen Yun'e 陳雲鶚 (registered in a civilian household of Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; an added student of the county school specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Xiangzhi; seventh in generational order; age twenty-nine, born on the seventeenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Chen Weiyi; his grandfather was Chen Suchu; his father is Chen Nong (invested as Case Reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review); his father's former wife was Lady Hong (posthumously invested as Peacewoman); and his mother is Lady Wu (invested as Peacewoman). Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Chen Yunpeng (Assistant Administration Commissioner of Shandong) and Chen Yunhan; his younger brother is Chen Yunfeng. He is married to Lady Lu. He placed thirty-seventh in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Wenbo 趙文博 (registered in a military household of Dai Subprefecture, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shouyue; second in generational order; age thirty, born on the fifteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhao Ziqi; his grandfather was Zhao Siming; his father was Zhao Zhong (District Magistrate); and his mother was Lady Zhang. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Zhao Wensheng; his younger brother is Zhao Wenjin. He is married to Lady Bai. He placed fifty-sixth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Heng 王衡 (registered in a civilian household of Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Wenzhan; first in generational order; age thirty-nine, born on the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Guangji; his grandfather was Wang Zhichong; his father is Wang Mu; and his mother is Lady Chen. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Wang Ji and Wang Guang. He is married to Lady Lin. He placed fifty-fourth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shao Tong 邵銅 (registered in a military household of Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; an added student of the prefectural school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhensheng; third in generational order; age forty-three, born on the twentieth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Shao Zongmei (a virtuous official in Min under the Yuan dynasty [?]); his grandfather was Shao Lang; his father was Shao Yuan; and his mother was Lady Ye. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Shao Liu and Shao Dun (official awaiting appointment). He married Lady Chen, and took a second Lady Chen as his successor wife. He placed second in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

黃紀〔貫四川潼川州遂寧縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字憲邦，行二，年三十一，五月十五日生〕。曾祖榮卿〔知府〕；祖文富〔知縣〕；父琮；嫡母吳氏，生母陳氏。具慶下。兄懷綱；弟懷端、懷正、懷鐗、懷傑。娶馮氏。四川鄉試第八名，會試第一百七十三名。

吳節〔貫直隸淮安府山陽縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字汝節，行四，年三十四，二月二十日生〕。曾祖允明〔元淮安路總管〕；祖仲熈〔知縣〕；父士通；母朱氏。具慶下。兄繼祖、汝霖、汝昇；弟汝誠。娶甯氏。應天府鄉試第一百七十八名，會試第一百七十八名。

陳雲〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《禮記》，字時望，行三，年二十八，十月二十五日生〕。曾祖仲賢；祖得祥；父玉成；母呂氏。慈侍下。兄霖、雷。娶黃氏。浙江鄉試第四十八名，會試第六十一名。

侯瓚〔貫直隸保定府雄縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字奉璋，行二，年二十八，十二月十三日生〕。曾祖世昌；祖文質；父林〔大使〕；母王氏。慈侍下。兄琰；弟琪。娶王氏。順天府鄉試第一百十九名，會試第二百三十五名。
translation_en:
Huang Ji 黃紀 [registered in a civilian household of Suining County 遂寧縣, Tongchuan Subprefecture 潼川州, Sichuan; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Xianbang 憲邦; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-one, born on the fifteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Rongqing 榮卿 [Prefect (zhifu)]; his grandfather was Huang Wenfu 文富 [County Magistrate (zhixian)]; his father is Huang Cong 琮; his legal mother is née Wu 吳氏, and his birth mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Huang Huaigang 懷綱, and his younger brothers are Huang Huaiduan 懷端, Huang Huaizheng 懷正, Huang Huaijian 懷鐗, and Huang Huaijie 懷傑. He married née Feng 馮氏. He placed eighth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 173rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Jie 吳節 [registered in a civilian household of Shanyang County 山陽縣, Huai'an Prefecture 淮安府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Rujie 汝節; fourth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-four, born on the twentieth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Yunming 允明 [Commander (zongguan) of Huai'an Route 淮安路 in the Yuan dynasty]; his grandfather was Wu Zhongxi 仲熈 [County Magistrate (zhixian)]; his father is Wu Shitong 士通; and his mother is née Zhu 朱氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wu Jizu 繼祖, Wu Rulin 汝霖, and Wu Rusheng 汝昇, and his younger brother is Wu Rucheng 汝誠. He married née Ning 甯氏. He placed 178th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 178th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yun 陳雲 [registered in a civilian household of Yuyao County 餘姚縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang; Added Student (zengguangsheng) at the county school; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Shiwang 時望; third in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Zhongxian 仲賢; his grandfather was Chen Dexiang 得祥; his father was Chen Yucheng 玉成; and his mother is née Lü 呂氏. His mother is living (his father having passed away). His elder brothers are Chen Lin 霖 and Chen Lei 雷. He married née Huang 黃氏. He placed forty-eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and sixty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hou Zan 侯瓚 [registered in a civilian household of Xiong County 雄縣, Baoding Prefecture 保定府, Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Fengzhang 奉璋; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Hou Shichang 世昌; his grandfather was Hou Wenzhi 文質; his father was Hou Lin 林 [Commissioner-in-chief (dashi)]; and his mother is née Wang 王氏. His mother is living (his father having passed away). His elder brother is Hou Yan 琰, and his younger brother is Hou Qi 琪. He married née Wang 王氏. He placed 119th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 235th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
魯崇志〔貫浙江台州府天台縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字崇志，行二，年三十三，四月二十日生〕。曾祖谷珍；祖友敬〔贈監察御史〕；父穆〔右僉都御史〕；母張氏〔封孺人〕。永感下。兄崇吉。娶奚氏。浙江鄉試第十七名，會試第六十二名。
郁文博〔貫直隸松江府上海縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字文博，行二，年二十七，十月二十八日生〕。曾祖清甫；祖謙；父昂〔典史〕；母印氏。嚴侍下。兄文盛。娶朱氏。應天府鄉試第三名，會試第二百九十六名。
馬進〔貫直隸淮安府山陽縣，錦衣衛官籍，國子生，治《書經》，字惟學，行四，年二十八，閏五月二十一日生〕。曾祖德驥；祖克讓；伯景隆〔錦衣衛千戶〕；父景中；母邢氏。慈侍下。兄惟欽；弟珎、瑾、顯、昂。娶張氏。順天府鄉試第八名，會試第二百七十二名。
李曰良〔貫江西廣信府弋陽縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字朝佐，行十二，年二十五，十月二十五日生〕。曾祖倫友；祖文安；叔祖奎〔大理少卿〕；父希愨；叔玘〔監察御史〕；母陸氏。重慶下。兄曰溫；弟曰儉。娶鄭氏。江西鄉試第四十七名，會試第三十二名。
translation_en:
Lu Chongzhi 魯崇志 [registered in a civilian household of Tiantai County 天台縣, Taizhou Prefecture 台州府, Zhejiang 浙江; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Chongzhi 崇志; second in seniority among his generation's brothers; thirty-three sui, born on the twentieth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Lu Guzhen 魯谷珍; his grandfather was Lu Youjing 魯友敬 [posthumously honored as Investigating Censor]; his father was Lu Mu 魯穆 [Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief]; and his mother was née Zhang 張氏 [invested as Child Nurturer]. Both parents were deceased. His elder brother was Lu Chongji 魯崇吉, and he married née Xi 奚氏. He placed seventeenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Wenbo 郁文博 [registered in a civilian household of Shanghai County 上海縣, Songjiang Prefecture 松江府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); County Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wenbo 文博; second in seniority among his generation's brothers; twenty-seven sui, born on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Yu Qingfu 郁清甫; his grandfather was Yu Qian 郁謙; his father is Yu Ang 郁昂 [Jail Warden]; and his mother was née Yin 印氏. His father is living and his mother deceased. His elder brother is Yu Wensheng 郁文盛, and he married née Zhu 朱氏. He placed third in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Jin 馬進 [native of Shanyang County 山陽縣, Huai'an Prefecture 淮安府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), registered in an official military household of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyiwei 錦衣衛); National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Weixue 惟學; fourth in seniority among his generation's brothers; twenty-eight sui, born on the twenty-first day of the intercalary fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Ma Deji 馬德驥; his grandfather was Ma Kerang 馬克讓; his paternal elder uncle was Ma Jinglong 馬景隆 [Battalion Commander in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard]; his father was Ma Jingzhong 馬景中; and his mother is née Xing 邢氏. His mother is living and his father deceased. His elder brother is Ma Weiqin 馬惟欽; his younger brothers are Ma Zhen 馬珎, Ma Jin 馬瑾, Ma Xian 馬顯, and Ma Ang 馬昂; and he married née Zhang 張氏. He placed eighth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yueliang 李曰良 [registered in a civilian household of Yiyang County 弋陽縣, Guangxin Prefecture 廣信府, Jiangxi 江西; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Chaozuo 朝佐; twelfth in seniority among his generation's brothers; twenty-five sui, born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Lunyou 李倫友; his grandfather is Li Wen'an 李文安; his grand-uncle is Li Kui 李奎 [Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review]; his father is Li Xique 李希愨; his paternal younger uncle is Li Qi 李玘 [Investigating Censor]; and his mother is née Lu 陸氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Li Yuewen 李曰溫; his younger brother is Li Yuejian 李曰儉; and he married née Zheng 鄭氏. He placed forty-seventh in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and thirty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xie Xing 謝省 (courtesy name Shixiu 世脩, first in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the twelfth day of the twelfth month) was registered in a civilian household of Huangyan County 黃巖縣, Taizhou Prefecture 台州府, Zhejiang 浙江, and was a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His great-grandfather was Xie Boxun 伯遜, his grandfather was Xie Yuancan 原參, his father was Xie Xingquan 性全, his mother was née Chen 陳氏, and his stepmother was née Chen 陳氏. Both his father and stepmother were living; his younger brothers were Xie Fu 復, Xie Xu 續, and Xie Ji 濟; he was married to a woman née Wang 王氏. He placed 86th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 330th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gao Ju 高舉 (courtesy name Ruxian 汝賢, first in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the fourteenth day of the sixth month) was registered in an artisan household of Wanping County 宛平縣, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府, natively of Shanghai County 上海縣, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), and was a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu). His great-grandfather was Gao Wenxian 文顯, his grandfather was Gao Deyuan 德源, his father was Gao Jing 敬, and his mother was née Ni 倪氏. Both his parents were living; his younger brothers were Gao Jue 爵 and Gao Lu 祿; he was married to a woman née Zheng 鄭氏. He placed 52nd in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 15th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lü Yi 呂益 (courtesy name Boqian 伯謙, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-second day of the third month) was registered in a civilian household of Xiangfu County 祥符縣, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南, and was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Lü Rongzhi 榮之, his grandfather was Lü Zhongxian 仲賢, his paternal elder uncle was Lü Ziming 子明 (Assistant Magistrate), his father was Lü Shiyong 世用, and his mother was née Zhang 張氏. Both his parents were living; his younger brothers were Lü Jin 錦, Lü Jian 鑑, Lü Zhao 釗, and Lü Quan 銓; he was married to a woman née Liu 劉氏. He placed 13th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 101st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jia Shi 賈奭 (courtesy name Xizhao 希召, first in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the fourteenth day of the eleventh month) was registered in a civilian household of Ba County 巴縣, Chongqing Prefecture 重慶府, Sichuan 四川, and was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Jia Jincheng 進成, his grandfather was Jia Wenfu 文富, his father was Jia Gui 珪 (County Magistrate), and his mother was née Wang 王氏. Both his parents were living; his younger brothers were Jia Yi 彛 and Jia Yi 彝 [? duplicate variant characters]; he was married to a woman née Li 李氏. He placed 3rd in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 263rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

His elder brother is Gang 綱. He married a woman née Liu 劉. He placed 66th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 209th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Gan 嚴淦 [native of Putian County 莆田縣, registered in the military household category of the Xinghua Guard 興化衛, Fujian 福建; National University Student; specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zongyuan 宗源; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one; born on the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhongzuo 仲作, his grandfather was Junliang 均良, his father was Mengqi 孟器, his mother was née Chen 陳, and his stepmother is née Lin 林. His mother (stepmother) is living while his father is deceased (cishi xia). His younger brothers are Gan 淦 [?], Pan 泮, and You 游. He married a woman née Li 李. He placed 12th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 20th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tu Huai 塗淮 [native of Jing'an County 靖安縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西, of civilian registration; National University Student; specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Dafu 達夫; sixteenth in seniority among his brothers and cousins; aged thirty-five; born on the eighth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Yike 益可, his grandfather was Boji 伯璣, his father is Fengshao 鳳韶, his father's former wife was née Liu 劉, his mother was née Yin 陰, and his stepmother is née Tu 涂. Both parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brothers are Jun 濬 and Wei 渭, and his younger brothers are Luo 洛 and Lian 濂. He married a woman née Shu 舒. He placed 42nd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 18th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Fu 沈富 [native of Qiantang County 錢塘縣, Hangzhou Prefecture 杭州府, Zhejiang 浙江, of civilian registration; Added Student (zengguangsheng) of the County School; specialized in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Haoli 好禮; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five; born on the fourteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Rulin 汝林, his grandfather was Tingguang 廷光, his father is Jingzong 敬宗, and his mother is née Wu 吳. Both parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brothers are Rong 榮 and Hua 華, and his younger brother is Gui 貴. He is betrothed to a woman née Jin 金. He placed 64th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 249th in the Metropolitan Examination.

董琳〔貫浙江寧波府鄞縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字廷瑞，行十，年二十八，正月十二日生〕。曾祖觀，祖伯莊，伯文衡〔知州〕，父文信，母劉氏。具慶下。兄宗、湮，弟珎。娶汪氏。浙江鄉試第九十六名，會試第十一名。

葉萱〔貫直隸松江府華亭縣民籍，府學生，治《春秋》，字廷茂，行二，年二十七，十月十四日生〕。曾祖庭玉，祖公武，父昂，母施氏。具慶下。兄蘭，弟蕙。娶莊氏。應天府鄉試第八十九名，會試第二百十七名。
translation_en:
Zhao Chang 趙昌 (registered under a military household in Jing County, Ningguo Prefecture, Directly Attached [Southern Zhili]; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Mingsheng; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine; born on the twenty-first day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Jineng, his grandfather was Tongfu, his father is Hongjian, and his mother is née Zong. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Mingqiu, Mingke, and Mingyang, and he is married to née Hu. He placed twenty-eighth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and one hundred and fifty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Ju 楊琚 (registered under a civilian household in Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Added Student of the County School; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Chaoyong; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five; born on the twenty-third day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhongmu (posthumously granted the title of Court Gentleman for Consultation), his grandfather was Dechong, his grand-uncle was Defu (Prefect), his paternal first cousin twice removed was Daohe (Vice Minister of the Seal Office), his father is Zixi, and his mother is née Xiao. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Ji and Chong, and he is married to née Xiao. He placed tenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and seventy-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Lin 董琳 (registered under a civilian household in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Tingrui; tenth in seniority among his brothers and cousins; aged twenty-eight; born on the twelfth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Guan, his grandfather was Bozhuang, his paternal uncle is Wenheng (Subprefectural Magistrate), his father is Wenxin, and his mother is née Liu. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zong and Yan, his younger brother is Zhen, and he is married to née Wang. He placed ninety-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and eleventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ye Xuan 葉萱 (registered under a civilian household in Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Directly Attached [Southern Zhili]; Prefectural School Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Tingmao; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven; born on the fourteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Tingyu, his grandfather was Gongwu, his father is Ang, and his mother is née Shi. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Lan, his younger brother is Hui, and he is married to née Zhuang. He placed eighty-ninth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and two hundred and seventeenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

尹直〔貫江西吉安府泰和縣儒籍，縣學增廣生，治《書經》，字正言，行六，年二十八，十月十五日生〕。曾祖天傳；祖子源〔大使〕；父自重；母蕭氏。具慶下。兄恂、恪、忻、愷、恮；弟慎、悝。娶曾氏。江西鄉試第五十六名，會試第三名。

translation_en:
Song Youwen 宋有文 [registered under a military household in Zi County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xianzhang; second in seniority among brothers; age forty, born on the third day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Churen, his grandfather was Junyi, his father was Jian, his paternal uncle was Yu [Police Chief], and his mother was née Liu. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Youcheng; his younger brothers are Youxue, You'an, You[?], Youzhe, Youqian, Youshan, and Youqing. He is married to a woman née Li. He placed thirteenth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and sixty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gui Chen 桂琛 [registered under a civilian household in Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xianzhi; sixth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-one, born on the twenty-first day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Xian, his grandfather was Xuanrong, his father is Rang, his mothers were née Xue and née Zhang, and his stepmother is née He. His father and stepmother are both alive. His elder brothers are Qi and Lin; his younger brothers are Cong, Ying, Cheng, Wu, Zan, Lian, and Tang. He is married to a woman née Yin. He placed twenty-fourth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yin Zhi 尹直 [registered under a Confucian scholar household in Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; an Added Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zhengyan; sixth in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the fifteenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Tianchuan, his grandfather was Ziyuan [Commissioner-in-chief], his father is Zizhong, and his mother is née Xiao. Both of his parents are alive. His elder brothers are Xun, Ke, Xin, Kai, and Quan; his younger brothers are Shen and Li. He is married to a woman née Zeng. He placed fifty-sixth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Gui 鄭珪 [registered under a civilian household in Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Shurun; fourth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-five, born on the twentieth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Yuanshi [Prefectural Vice Prefect], his grandfather was Deyi, his father is Xin, and his mother is née Shen. Both of his parents are alive. His elder brothers are Fan, Yu, and Chen; his younger brother is Zhang. He is married to a woman née Xia. He placed forty-ninth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Jiao Xian 焦顯 (registered in a military household of De Subprefecture, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Wenming; first in his generation; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-third day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Jiao Yi; his grandfather was Jiao Fushan; his father is Jiao Sheng, and his mother is née Guo. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Jiao Hao. He married née Li. He placed 95th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 136th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Du Qian 杜謙 (registered in a civilian household of Changli County, Yongping Prefecture, Zhili; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Yizhi; third in his generation; aged thirty-six, born on the twelfth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Du Yanwen; his grandfather was Du Fuzu; his father is Du Min, his father's former wife was née Yang, his mother was née Wang, and his stepmother is née Dong. His father is living. His elder brothers are Du Gong and Du Sheng. He married née Yang. He placed 77th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 28th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qu Quan 屈銓 (registered in a civilian household of Lucheng County, Lu Subprefecture, Shanxi; Added Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Tianheng; fifth in his generation; aged twenty-eight, born on the thirteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Qu Wenzhong; his grandfather was Qu Jingzong; his father is Qu Yin (Instructor), and his mother is née Sun. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Qu Jian, Qu Ming, Qu Qian, and Qu Rong. He married née Shen. He placed 1st in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 131st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Shirang 林時讓 (registered in a civilian household of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; Confucian Scholar; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Chunli; second in his generation; aged thirty-two, born on the nineteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Lin Ji (Prefectural Judge under the Yuan); his grandfather was Lin Daochuan; his father is Lin Si (Vice Director in the Ministry of Works), his mother was née Huang, and his stepmother is née Chen. His father and stepmother are living. His elder brother is Lin Shihou, and his younger brothers are Lin Shigong and Lin Shiqian. He married née Song, and remarried née Wang. He placed 55th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 197th in the Metropolitan Examination.

嚴侍下 兄宗本 宗政 宗信 弟宗道 宗昭 宗顯 宗志 娶曹氏 繼娶岳氏
山東鄉試第三名 會試第二百十一名
吳顯 貫浙江紹興府山陰縣民籍 縣學增廣生
治詩經字文謨行二年二十五五月二十四日生
曾祖印 祖永富 父慶 母周氏
具慶下 兄昱 弟鼎 頡 顥 傾 娶陳氏
浙江鄉試第四十四名 會試第二百三十七名
punctuated:
劉溥〔貫江西吉安府廬陵縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《易經》，字濬淵，行二，年二十九，二月十四日生〕。曾祖啓隆，祖紹先，父如躍，母彭氏，繼母彭氏。重慶下。兄深，弟湍、澄、浩、漢。娶彭氏。江西鄉試第一百二十六名，會試第一百四十七名。
鄭瑛〔貫應天府六合縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字邦潤，行六，年三十三，五月二十三日生〕。曾祖文淵，祖思敬，父惟鈞，叔猷〔翰林檢討〕，嫡母許氏，母陳氏。慈侍下。兄邦贄、邦瑞、邦器、冕〔監察御史〕。娶李氏。應天府鄉試第四十九名，會試第一百十九名。
李宗學〔貫山東兗州府嶧縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字致用，行四，年三十八，正月二十二日生〕。曾祖興，祖希榮，父謙〔教諭〕，母丁氏。嚴侍下。兄宗本、宗政、宗信，弟宗道、宗昭〔宗顯、宗志〕。娶曹氏，繼娶岳氏。山東鄉試第三名，會試第二百十名。
吳顯〔貫浙江紹興府山陰縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《詩經》，字文謨，行二，年二十五，五月二十四日生〕。曾祖印，祖永富，父慶，母周氏。具慶下。兄昱，弟鼎、顒、顎、頒。娶陳氏。浙江鄉試第四十四名，會試第二百三十七名。
translation_en:
Liu Pu 劉溥 (registered in a civilian household of Luling County 廬陵縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; Added Student of the County School, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Junyuan 濬淵; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the fourteenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Liu Qilong 啓隆, his grandfather was Liu Shaoxian 紹先, his father is Liu Ruyue 如躍, his mother was née Peng 彭氏, and his stepmother is née Peng 彭氏. Both grandparents and parents are living. His elder brother is Liu Shen 深, and his younger brothers are Liu Tuan 湍, Liu Cheng 澄, Liu Hao 浩, and Liu Han 漢. He married née Peng 彭氏. He placed 126th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 147th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Ying 鄭瑛 (registered in a military household of Liuhe County 六合縣, Yingtian Prefecture 應天府; Directorate Student, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Bangrun 邦潤; sixth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-third day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Zheng Wenyuan 文淵, his grandfather was Zheng Sijing 思敬, his father was Zheng Weijun 惟鈞, his paternal uncle is Zheng You 猷 (Examining Editor in the Hanlin Academy), his legal mother was née Xu 許氏, and his birth mother is née Chen 陳氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Zheng Bangzhi 邦贄, Zheng Bangrui 邦瑞, Zheng Bangqi 邦器, and Zheng Mian 冕 (Investigating Censor). He married née Li 李氏. He placed 49th in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and 119th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Zongxue 李宗學 (registered in a civilian household of Yi County 嶧縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 兗州府, Shandong 山東; Directorate Student, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Zhiyong 致用; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the twenty-second day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Li Xing 興, his grandfather was Li Xirong 希榮, his father is Li Qian 謙 (Instructor), and his mother was née Ding 丁氏. His father is living. His elder brothers are Li Zongben 宗本, Li Zongzheng 宗政, and Li Zongxin 宗信, and his younger brothers are Li Zongdao 宗道, Li Zongzhao 宗昭, Li Zongxian 宗顯, and Li Zongzhi 宗志. He married née Cao 曹氏, and took née Yue 岳氏 as his second wife. He placed 3rd in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 210th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Xian 吳顯 (registered in a civilian household of Shanyin County 山陰縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang 浙江; Added Student of the County School, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Wenmo 文謨; second in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-fourth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Wu Yin 印, his grandfather was Wu Yongfu 永富, his father is Wu Qing 慶, and his mother is née Zhou 周氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Wu Yu 昱, and his younger brothers are Wu Ding 鼎, Wu Yong 顒, Wu E 顎, and Wu Ban 頒. He married née Chen 陳氏. He placed 44th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 237th in the Metropolitan Examination.
