punctuated:
周瑛〔貫貴州都司興隆衛官籍，衛學官生，治《春秋》，字廷潤，行三，年二十六，九月十二日生〕。曾祖德誠；祖庸二；父政；母姜氏。具慶下。兄鑑〔副千戶〕、鎮；弟銘。娶謝氏。雲南鄉試第十一名，會試第八十七名。

劉倫正〔貫江西吉安府安福縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《春秋》，字理敘，行二，年三十二，九月二十九日生〕。曾祖敏文；祖子懋；父素絢；母朱氏，繼母吳氏。具慶下。兄倫建；弟倫徽。娶湯氏。江西鄉試第六十七名，會試第二百六十七名。

陳貴〔貫福建興化府莆田縣民籍，府學生，治《書經》，字秉良，行三，年二十，八月初五日生〕。曾祖福貳；祖伯榮；父宏濱；嫡母朱氏，母廖氏。慈侍下。兄福生、昇生。娶吳氏。福建鄉試第一百一十九名，會試第二百七十九名。

傅韶〔貫江西吉安府永豐縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《易經》，字德音，行三，年二十五，十一月二十五日生〕。曾祖以忠〔贈兵部主事〕；祖仲球〔兵部主事〕；父曰顯；母胡氏，庶母羅氏。具慶下。兄德元、德亨；弟德貞。娶許氏。江西鄉試第一百二名，會試第七十六名。
translation_en:
Zhou Ying 周瑛 (registered under an hereditary military officer household in Xinglong Guard under the Guizhou Regional Military Commission; an official student at the Guard Confucian School; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Tingrun; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twelfth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Decheng, his grandfather was Zhou Yong'er, his father is Zhou Zheng, and his mother is née Jiang. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhou Jian (Assistant Battalion Commander) and Zhou Zhen; his younger brother is Zhou Ming. He is married to née Xie. He placed eleventh in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Lunzheng 劉倫正 (registered under a commoner household in Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; an added student at the County Confucian School; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Lixu; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-ninth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Minwen, his grandfather was Liu Zimao, his father is Liu Suxuan, his late mother was née Zhu, and his stepmother is née Wu. His father and stepmother are both living. His elder brother is Liu Lunjian, and his younger brother is Liu Lunhui. He is married to née Tang. He placed sixty-seventh in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Gui 陳貴 (registered under a commoner household in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; a student at the Prefectural Confucian School; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Bingliang; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty, born on the fifth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Fu'er, his grandfather was Chen Borong, his father was Chen Hongbin, his father's principal wife was née Zhu, and his birth mother is née Liao. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Chen Fusheng and Chen Shengsheng. He is married to née Wu. He placed one hundred nineteenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fu Shao 傅韶 (registered under a commoner household in Yongfeng County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; an added student at the County Confucian School; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Deyin; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-fifth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Fu Yizhong (posthumously granted the title of Secretary in the Ministry of War), his grandfather was Fu Zhongqiu (Secretary in the Ministry of War), his father is Fu Yuexian, his mother is née Hu, and his father's concubine is née Luo. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Fu Deyuan and Fu Deheng; his younger brother is Fu Dezhen. He is married to née Xu. He placed one hundred second in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and seventy-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
袁潤〔貫江西南昌府豐城縣軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字習德，行九，年三十六，十一月初九日生〕。曾祖希魯；祖仲華；父文溥；前母何氏，母涂氏。慈侍下。兄習清、習遠、習美；弟習寛、習容、習緒。娶晏氏。江西鄉試第五名，會試第八十八名。

楊恕〔貫江西九江府湖口縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字尚忠，行九，年三十一，七月初四日生〕。曾祖庚三；祖清二；父文勝；前母夏氏，母李氏。永感下。兄懋、惠；弟志。娶段氏，継娶黄氏。江西鄉試第一百六名，會試第二百五十三名。

趙博〔貫直隸蘇州府崐山縣匠籍，增廣生，治《易經》，字克周，行六，年三十一，九月二十五日生〕。曾祖文善〔元醫學提領〕；祖子良〔醫士〕；父恭；母曹氏，繼母朱氏。慈侍下。兄讓、誾、鑑、敏、勉〔署訓導事舉人〕。娶王氏，繼娶沈氏。應天府鄉試第一百三十名，會試第二百五十二名。

范文〔貫浙江台州府臨海縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《書經》，字德彰，行五，年二十二，七月初二日生〕。曾祖用善；祖居安；父宗〔知府〕；母王氏。慈侍下。兄炳、蔚、盛、京；弟祿。娶張氏。浙江鄉試第一百四十一一名，會試第二十七名。
translation_en:
Yuan Run 袁潤 (registered in a military household of Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Xide 習德; ninth in generational seniority; aged thirty-six, born on the ninth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Yuan Xilu 希魯; his grandfather was Yuan Zhonghua 仲華; his father was Yuan Wenpu 文溥; his father's former wife was née He 何氏, and his mother is née Tu 涂氏. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Yuan Xiqing 習清, Yuan Xiyuan 習遠, and Yuan Ximei 習美; his younger brothers are Yuan Xikuan 習寛, Yuan Xirong 習容, and Yuan Xixu 習緒. He married née Yan 晏氏. He ranked 5th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 88th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Shu 楊恕 (registered in a civilian household of Hukou County, Jiujiang Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Shangzhong 尚忠; ninth in generational seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the fourth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Yang Gengsan 庚三; his grandfather was Yang Qing'er 清二; his father was Yang Wensheng 文勝; his father's former wife was née Xia 夏氏, and his mother was née Li 李氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yang Mao 懋 and Yang Hui 惠; his younger brother is Yang Zhi 志. He married née Duan 段氏 and remarried née Huang 黄氏. He ranked 106th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 253rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Bo 趙博 (registered in an artisan household of Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; Additional Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Kezhou 克周; sixth in generational seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Zhao Wenshan 文善 (Medical Superintendent under the Yuan dynasty); his grandfather was Zhao Ziliang 子良 (Medical Practitioner); his father was Zhao Gong 恭; his mother was née Cao 曹氏, and his stepmother is née Zhu 朱氏. His stepmother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Zhao Rang 讓, Zhao Yin 誾, Zhao Jian 鑑, Zhao Min 敏, and Zhao Mian 勉 (provincial graduate (juren) serving as Acting Assistant Instructor). He married née Wang 王氏 and remarried née Shen 沈氏. He ranked 130th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 252nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fan Wen 范文 (registered in a civilian household of Linhai County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; County School Additional Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Dezhang 德彰; fifth in generational seniority; aged twenty-two, born on the second day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Fan Yongshan 用善; his grandfather was Fan Ju'an 居安; his father was Fan Zong 宗 (Prefect); his mother is née Wang 王氏. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Fan Bing 炳, Fan Wei 蔚, Fan Sheng 盛, and Fan Jing 京; his younger brother is Fan Lu 祿. He married née Zhang 張氏. He ranked 141st [?; text has 第一百四十一一名] in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 27th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Guo Zhongxun 郭仲珣 (registered under a military household in the Hejian Guard, native of Kaizhou in North Zhili; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shuyu, second in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-third day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Yuanli (Left Assistant Director of the Secretariat under the Yuan, posthumously awarded the title Meritorious Minister Who Reveres Transformation, Exerts Strength, and Renders Loyalty, with the posthumous name Duke Zhonglie); his grandfather was Xidao (Registrar of the Bureau of Military Affairs under the Yuan); his father was Zongyi, and his mother is née Zhang. His mother is living; his elder brother is Zhongxuan, and he is married to née Lü. He placed ninety-fourth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and three hundred thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Xun 江勛 (registered under a civilian household in Fenghua County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; County Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yuanxun, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the thirteenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Shaozu; his grandfather was Huanzong; his father was Shangzhi, his legal mother was née Su, and his birth mother is née Liu. His mother is living; his elder brothers are Mian and Xiao, his younger brother is Ji, and he is married to née Wang. He placed seventy-eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Lin 汪霖 (registered under a civilian household in Lu'an Subprefecture, Luzhou Prefecture, South Zhili; Added Student at the Subprefectural School, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Runfu, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-first day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Jingdao (District Magistrate); his grandfather is Kejing; his father is Hong (Assistant Instructor), and his mother is née Zhang. Both his parents and grandparents are living; his younger brothers are Ji, Li, and Kui, and he is married to née Zhang. He placed seventy-eighth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shan Ang 單昻 (registered under a Confucian scholar household in Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Added Student at the County School, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Tingju, second in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the sixth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Siqi; his grandfather was Xin (Instructor); his father is Benyuan, and his mother is née Guo. Both his parents are living; his elder brother is Mian, his younger brother is Li, and he is married to née Xiao. He placed one hundred fifty-ninth in the [illegible] Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Feng Zai 豐載 [registered in a civilian household of Anfu County 安福縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; an added student of the county school specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing 易經); style name Chihou 持厚; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-eighth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Feng Shou 壽; his grandfather was Feng Zihong 子弘; his father is Feng Limin 黎敏 and his mother is née Yi 易氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brother is Feng Daosheng 道昇. He married a woman née Wang 王氏. He ranked sixty-fourth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred seventeenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Long Jin 龍晉 [registered in a military household of the Nanjing Right Guard of the Navy 南京水軍右衛, originally from Jishui County 吉水縣, Jiangxi 江西; a military student of the Yingtian Prefectural School 應天府學 specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing 詩經); style name Zunxu 遵敘; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the tenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Long Bohong 伯洪; his grandfather was Long Shuzheng 叔政; his father is Long Congya 從雅 and his mother is née Song 宋氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Long Zunxian 遵憲; his younger paternal cousin is Long Lin 霖 [a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the same examination]; his younger brothers are Long Zunqi 遵啓, Long Zunming 遵明, and Long Zunwen 遵文. He married a woman née Ouyang 歐陽氏. He ranked sixty-fifth in the Yingtian 應天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Zheng 顏正 [registered in an artisan household of Huating County 華亭縣, Songjiang Prefecture 松江府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸); a student of the county school specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing 書經); style name Tingbiao 廷表; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twentieth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Yan Bayan 伯顏 [Prefectural Instructor of the Yuan dynasty]; his grandfather was Yan You 有 [Assistant Magistrate]; his father is Yan Fu 復 and his mother is née Guo 郭氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Yan Duan 端; his younger brother is Yan Xiang 祥. He married a woman née Pan 潘氏. He ranked fourth in the Yingtian 應天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Hai 徐海 [registered in a Confucian scholar household of Yuyao County 餘姚縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang 浙江; an added student of the county school specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji 禮記); style name Derong 德容; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the seventh day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Jishi 季實; his grandfather was Xu Yuping 與平; his father is Xu Zhongying 仲瑛 and his mother is née Wang 王氏. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Xu Bo 渤 and Xu Ying 瀛. He married a woman née Wei 魏氏. He ranked one hundred fourth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Yang Fu 楊釜 [native of Changtai County 長泰縣, Zhangzhou Prefecture 漳州府, Fujian, of civilian registration (minji); a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shoudiao 受調; third in generational rank; age twenty-five, born on the tenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Zongcong 宗𤪌, his grandfather was Yang Maozhi 茂之, his father is Yang Fuyi 復一, and his mother is née Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brothers are Yang Yi 鎰 and Yang Jun 鈞; his younger brothers are Yang Zheng 錚, Yang Zi 錙, Yang Zhu 銖, Yang Tie 鉄, Yang Qian 鉛, and Yang Kuang 鑛. He is married to née Liu 劉氏. He placed 55th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 329th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Qi 周琦 [native of Yongkang County 永康縣, Jinhua Prefecture 金華府, Zhejiang, of civilian registration; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Zongyu 宗玉; fourteenth in generational rank; age twenty-eight, born on the eighth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Bowen 伯文, his grandfather was Zhou Shumao 叔茂, his father was Zhou Yangcai 養才, and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brother is Zhou Xiang 珦; his younger brothers are Zhou Zhang 璋, Zhou Gui 珪, and Zhou Yu 瑜. He is married to née Mou 牟氏. He placed 33rd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 69th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Yongtong 劉永通 [native of Dangtu County 當塗縣, Taiping Prefecture 太平府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), of artisan registration (jiangji); an Added Student (zengguang sheng) of the Prefectural School specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Hongji 弘濟; first in generational rank; age twenty-six, born on the fourth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Gui 貴, his grandfather was Liu De 德, his father is Liu Yu 瑀, and his mother is née Zhang 張氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Liu Yongqing 永清, Liu Yongming 永明, and Liu Yonghong 永洪. He is married to née Tang 唐氏. He placed 126th in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 246th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Wenkui 鄭文奎 [native of Chaoyang County 潮陽縣, Chaozhou Prefecture 潮州府, Guangdong, of civilian registration; a National University Student specializing in the Book of Documents; courtesy name Yongzhang 永章; second in generational rank; age thirty-three, born on the sixth day of the intercalary twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Ziyuan 子原, his grandfather was Zheng Chou 稠, his father is Zheng Shangyin 上蔭, and his mother is née Xiao 蕭氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Zheng Wenbi 文璧, and his younger brother is Zheng Wencan 文參. He is married to née Guo 郭氏. He placed 26th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 377th in the Metropolitan Examination.

鍾珹〔貫直隸太平府當塗縣軍籍，府學生，治《詩經》，字德卿，行三，年三十，二十月初一日生〕。曾祖應庚；祖鎮；父福，母陳氏。慈侍下。兄瑛、璿。娶朱氏。應天府鄉試第一百六十名，會試第三十名。

劉璧〔貫江西吉安府永新縣官籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字次瑋，行四，年三十三，八月初一日生〕。曾祖樂善〔知府〕；祖汝裘〔封翰林院檢討〕；伯麟應〔翰林院脩撰〕；父顯智，母王氏。慈侍下。兄瑊〔兵科給事中〕，弟珝。娶湯氏，繼娶賀氏。江西鄉試第一百二十三名，會試第一百六十四名。

translation_en:
Li Mu 李木 (registered in an official household in Cao County, Cao Subprefecture, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a student in the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shisheng; third in his generation; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-eighth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Kekuan (Battalion Commander); his grandfather was Wengui (Secretary in the Ministry of Works); his father was Xing, his principal mother was née Ge, and his birth mother was née Dong. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Tong and Heng, and his younger brothers are Liang and Qi; he married a woman née Chen. He placed thirty-second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred and thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhong Cheng 鍾珹 (registered in a military household in Dangtu County, Taiping Prefecture, Directly Attached [Southern Metropolitan Region]; a prefectural student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Deqing; third in his generation; aged thirty-two, born on the first day of the tenth month [or aged thirty, born on the first day of the twelfth month [?]]). His great-grandfather was Yinggeng; his grandfather was Zhen; his father was Fu, and his mother was née Chen. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Ying and Xuan; he married a woman née Zhu. He placed one hundred and sixtieth in the Yingtian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Bi 劉璧 (registered in an official household in Yongxin County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a county student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Ciwei; fourth in his generation; aged thirty-three, born on the first day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Leshan (Prefect); his grandfather was Ruqiu (granted the prestige title of Examining Editor in the Hanlin Academy); his paternal elder uncle was Linying (Senior Compiler in the Hanlin Academy); his father was Xianzhi, and his mother was née Wang. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brother is Jian (Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for War), and his younger brother is Xu; he married a woman née Tang, and subsequently married a woman née He. He placed one hundred and twenty-third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and sixty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Bin 唐彬 (registered in a civilian household in Shanyin County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a student in the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhifu; second in his generation; aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-first day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Yunzhong; his grandfather was Min; his father is Jing, and his mother is née Zhao. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Biao; he married a woman née Ru. He placed twelfth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Li Min 李敏: Registered in Xiangcheng County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, under a civilian household. He specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing). His style name is Gongmian, he is the third son in his generation, and he is thirty years old, born on the fifteenth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Li Zhonghe, his grandfather was Li Kezheng, his father is Li Ang, and his mother is née Shang; both parents are living. His elder brothers are Li Shou and Li Hai; his younger brothers are Li Qi, Li Jing, Li Xiao, and Li Fu. He married née Wang. He ranked 22nd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 63rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qian Yuan 錢源: Registered in the Yingzhou Right Tun Guard under the Daning Regional Military Commission as a military household, originally from Kunshan County. A student of the Jizhou Subprefectural School, he specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji). His style name is Youben, he is the fifth son in his generation, and he is twenty-five years old, born on the tenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Qian Gonglu, his grandfather was Qian Minze, his father is Qian Yongduan, and his mother was née Xu; his father is living. His elder paternal cousin is Qian Jun (a metropolitan graduate of the same examination class); his younger brothers are Qian Yong, Qian Wen, Qian Fu, and Qian Bin. He married née Zhao, and took as his second wife [two characters illegible]. He ranked 5th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 70th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Third Tier (Disanjia), 227 candidates, conferred the status of Associate Metropolitan Graduate (Tong jinshi chushen).

Cui Zhong 崔忠: Registered in Xincheng County, Baoding Prefecture, Zhili, under a civilian household. He specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu). His style name is Chengzhi, he is the fifth son in his generation, and he is twenty-eight years old, born on the seventeenth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Cui Jin, his grandfather was Cui Xing, his father is Cui Li (Prefectural Medical Instructor), and his mother is [two characters illegible]; both parents are living. His elder brothers are Cui Cong, Cui Ming, Cui Gong, Cui Rui, and Cui Zhi (Prefectural Medical Instructor); his younger brothers are Cui Shu and Cui Si [three characters illegible, likely including his wife's surname]. He ranked 36th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 291st in the Metropolitan Examination.

王常〔貫四川馬湖府平夷長官司民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字正倫，行三，年二十八，六月十四日生〕。曾祖景中；祖琰；伯俊〔州同知〕；父有問；叔有學〔教諭〕；母田氏。永感下。兄德昭、德安；弟德榮、德宣。娶劉氏。四川鄉試第三十四名，會試第一百四十四名。
translation_en:
Pan Jie 潘傑 [registered in an artisan household of Shangyuan County, Yingtian Prefecture; a Confucian scholar specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shiying; fourth in generational seniority; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-sixth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Pan Yuanqing (an Instructor in the Yuan dynasty), his grandfather was Pan Gang, his father was Pan Ning, and his mother is née Lu. His mother is living. He has elder brothers Pan Zhen, Pan Xiang, and Pan Jun, and is married to Lady Sun. He placed eighth in the Yingtian Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Fu 胡福 [registered in an artisan household of Yifeng County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Baishun; first in generational seniority; aged twenty-seven, born on the eleventh day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Hu Youdao, his grandfather was Hu Zhizhong, his father was Hu Rang, and his mother is née Zheng. His mother is living. He has younger brothers Hu Lu and Hu Shou, and is married to Lady Wang. He placed sixteenth in the Henan Provincial Examination and seventy-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Yi 徐毅 [registered in an artisan household of Shangyuan County, Yingtian Prefecture, originally from Xi'an County, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Shihong; first in generational seniority; aged thirty, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Fu, his grandfather was Xu Yanming, his father was Xu Zongliang, his mother was née Yan, and his stepmother is née Zou. His stepmother is living. He has younger brothers Xu Gang, Xu Qing, Xu Shan, and Xu Qing, and was married to Lady Zhao and remarried to Lady Chen. He placed thirteenth in the Yingtian Provincial Examination and ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Chang 王常 [registered in a civilian household of the Pingyi Chief's Office, Mahu Prefecture, Sichuan; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhenglun; third in generational seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the fourteenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Jingzhong, his grandfather was Wang Yan, his elder paternal uncle is Wang Jun (a Subprefectural Vice Magistrate), his father was Wang Youwen, his younger paternal uncle is Wang Youxue (an Instructor), and his mother was née Tian. Both of his parents are deceased. He has elder brothers Wang Dezhao and Wang De'an, and younger brothers Wang Derong and Wang Dexuan, and is married to Lady Liu. He placed thirty-fourth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:

徐宗〔貫四川重慶府榮昌縣軍籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字大本，行二，年三十六，六月初四日生〕。曾祖仲珉，祖以敬，父思慧，母李氏。具慶下。兄大倫，弟大材、大節。娶熊氏。四川鄉試第六十名，會試第三百十四名。

熊俊〔貫湖廣武昌府江夏縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字子英，行一，年三十一，十二月二十七日生〕。曾祖自遠，祖璠〔楚府教授〕，父鼒，母涂氏。具慶下。弟傑、份、俁、健。娶劉氏。湖廣鄉試第九名，會試第一百三十四名。

錢俊〔貫大寧都司營州右屯衛軍籍，直隸崑山縣人，薊州學生，治《禮記》，字時乂，行四，年二十九，正月十五日生〕。曾祖公路，祖民則，父仲進，母王氏。慈侍下。兄安、英、傑，從弟源〔同科進士〕。娶王氏。順天府鄉試第八十九名，會試第二百六十名。
translation_en:
Li Bao 李褒 [registered under a military household in Luling County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Added Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jimei 濟美; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-first day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Yunzhong 允忠, his grandfather was Yihe 以和, his father was Mengrang 孟讓, and his mother is née Chen 陳. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Chengmei 成美 and Chengxin 成信, and he is married to Lady Xiahou 夏侯. He placed 220th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 220th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Zong 徐宗 [registered under a military household in Rongchang County, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Daben 大本; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the fourth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhongmin 仲珉, his grandfather was Yijing 以敬, his father is Sihui 思慧, and his mother is née Li 李. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Dalun 大倫, his younger brothers are Dacai 大材 and Dajie 大節, and he is married to Lady Xiong 熊. He placed 60th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 314th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiong Jun 熊俊 [registered under a civilian household in Jiangxia County, Wuchang Prefecture, Huguang; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Ziying 子英; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Ziyuan 自遠, his grandfather was Fan 璠 [Instructor in the Princely Establishment of Chu], his father is Zi 鼒, and his mother is née Tu 涂. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Jie 傑, Bin 份, Yu 俁, and Jian 健, and he is married to Lady Liu 劉. He placed 9th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 134th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qian Jun 錢俊 [registered under a military household in the Yingzhou Right Tun Guard under the Daning Regional Military Commission, originally from Kunshan County, Zhili; Student of the Jizhou Subprefectural School; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Shiyi 時乂; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the fifteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Gonglu 公路, his grandfather was Minze 民則, his father was Zhongjin 仲進, and his mother is née Wang 王. His mother is living. His elder brothers are An 安, Ying 英, and Jie 傑; his younger paternal cousin is Yuan 源 [a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the same examination]; and he is married to Lady Wang 王. He placed 89th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 260th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhang Hao 張浩, registered in a military household of the Lizhou Battalion under the Huguang Regional Military Commission, was a National University Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); his style name was Yangzheng, he was second in seniority among his brothers, and he was thirty-three sui, born on the twelfth day of the intercalary tenth month. His great-grandfather was Zhang Zhen, his grandfather was Zhang Cheng, his father was Zhang Yiren, and his mother was née Ma. His mother was living (his father having passed away); he had an elder brother Bin and younger brothers Wen, Run, and Lin, and he was married to née Wang. He placed twenty-eighth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Chen 王臣, registered in a civilian household of Chang'an County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi, was a County Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); his style name was Gongfu, he was third in seniority, and he was twenty-eight sui, born on the twenty-sixth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Wang Liang (an Assistant Surveillance Commissioner under the Yuan dynasty), his grandfather was Wang Zengyu (a Battalion Commander), his father was Wang Gui, and his mother was née Zhang. Both of his parents were living; he had elder brothers Long and Sheng, and he was married to née Hui. He placed thirteenth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and eighty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Zheng 陳政, registered in a military household of Panyu County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong, was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); his style name was Xuanzhi, he was third in seniority, and he was thirty-six sui, born on the fourth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Chen Yiqian, his grandfather was Chen Zuyong, his father was Chen En, and his mother was née Tan. Both of his parents were deceased; he had elder brothers Qizheng and Wuzheng and younger brothers Qinzheng and Bingzheng, and he was married to née Qin. He placed first in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and one hundred ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Xian 劉顯, registered in a military household of Xinhua County, Baoqing Prefecture, Huguang, was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); his style name was Guangzu, he was second in seniority, and he was thirty-three sui, born on the ninth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Liu Wenxin, his grandfather was Liu Chuzhen, his father was Liu Cun (a District Magistrate), his legal mother was née Zou, and his birth mother was née Zhang. Both of his parents were living; he had an elder brother Chang and a younger brother Zhao, and he was married to née Lu. He placed thirty-fifth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yi 李益 [registered in a civilian household of Chang'an County 長安縣, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi 陝西; Added Student (zengguang sheng) of the County School; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Jingxian 景賢; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the second day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Li Junyan 李均彦 [posthumously honored as Transmission Commissioner (tongzheng shi) of the Office of Transmission], his grandfather was Li Zeyong 李則庸 [posthumously honored as Transmission Commissioner of the Office of Transmission], his father was Li Xian 李暹 [Left Vice Minister of Revenue (hubu zuo shilang)], his principal mother was Lady Lü 呂氏 [posthumously honored as Lady of Virtue (shuren)], and his birth mother was Lady Zhang 張氏 [invested as Lady of Virtue]. Ning Zhen 甯珍 [registered in a physician household of Dantu County 丹徒縣, Zhenjiang Prefecture 鎮江府, Directly Attached Region (Zhili); Medical Student (yishi sheng) in the Imperial Academy of Medicine; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Bozhen 伯珍; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the sixteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Ning Zhongshan 甯仲山, his grandfather was Ning Yancheng 甯彥誠, his paternal uncle was Ning Degang 甯得剛 [Prefectural Vice Prefect (fu tongzhi)], his father was Ning Dezhong 甯得中 [Administrative Assistant (yuanpan) of the Imperial Academy of Medicine], and his mother is Lady Song 宋氏. With both parents living (juqing xia), he has elder brothers Ning Zan 甯瓚 and Ning Rong 甯瑢, and a younger brother Ning Cong 甯琮; he is married to Lady Huang 黃氏. Wang Chun 王春 [registered in an artisan household of Jining Subprefecture 濟寧州, Yanzhou Prefecture 兖州府, Shandong 山東; Student of the Subprefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zaiyang 載陽; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the nineteenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Zhengxing 王正興, his grandfather was Wang Jixian 王繼先, his father is Wang Zongqi 王宗器 [Vice Subprefect (zhou tongzhi)], and his mother is Lady Gao 高氏. With both parents living, he has elder brothers Wang Feng 王鳳, Wang Heng 王衡, and Wang Xian 王賢, and younger brothers Wang Zuo 王佐, Wang Yi 王儀, Wang Jun 王俊, Wang Lun 王倫, and Wang Yan 王儼; he is married to Lady Zhang 張氏. He placed fourth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and fifty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Desheng 胡德盛 [registered in a civilian household of Dexing County 德興縣, Raozhou Prefecture 饒州府, Jiangxi 江西; Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shangyu 尚愚; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the fourth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Hu Shihua 胡士華, his grandfather was Hu Shengzong 胡勝宗, his father is Hu Xuansheng 胡懸生, his mother was Lady Hong 洪氏, and his stepmother is Lady Cheng 程氏. With both parents living, he has an elder brother Hu Daolong 胡道隆, and younger brothers Hu Si 胡禠, Hu Xiang 胡祥, Hu Hao 胡浩, and Hu Bin 胡濱; he is married to Lady Wang 汪氏. He placed fifty-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Zeng Ruzhi, his grandfather was Zeng Chengzong, his father was Zeng Sijing, and his mother is née Wang. His mother is living (his father is deceased). He has an elder brother, Zeng Yu, and younger brothers, Zeng Bi and Zeng Qi. He married née Liu. He placed twenty-second in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and eighty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhai Zheng 翟政 [registered in a civilian household in Anyang County, Zhangde Prefecture, Henan; a County School Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yide; fourth in generational order; age twenty-six, born on the fourth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Zhai Weizhong, his grandfather was Zhai Tong, his father was Zhai Kui [Tribute Student], and his mother is née Feng. His mother is living (his father is deceased). He has elder brothers Zhai Wei, Zhai Rong, and Zhai Mao. He married née Guo. He placed twenty-eighth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fang Kui 方逵 [registered in a military household in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; an Added Student of the Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Jingyou; fifth in generational order; age twenty-eight, born on the first day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Fang Hui, his grandfather was Fang Fu, his father is Fang Zhi, and his mother is née Lin. Both of his parents are living. He has elder brothers Fang Shu [Vice Prefect], Fang Da, Fang Sui, and Fang Xuan. He married née Wu. He placed sixty-fourth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qian Lian 錢璉 [registered in a civilian household in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Tingzhen; second in generational order; age thirty-five, born on the second day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Qian Kangfu, his grandfather was Qian Yinchu, his father is Qian Xiangsou, and his mother is née Zhang. Both of his parents are living. He has an elder brother, Qian Gui. He married née Zhu. He placed fifteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred sixtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zheng Tong 鄭同 (registered under a military household in Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals; courtesy name Benchu, second in seniority, aged twenty-nine, born on the nineteenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Zheng Jiye (Instructor); his grandfather was Zheng Tianci; his father is Zheng Zong; and his mother is née Chen. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Zheng Geng, Zheng Hua, and Zheng Gui. He is married to née Xue. He ranked fourth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Ji 王紀 (registered under a military household in Xunan Guard, Sichuan; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Zhaoxiu, first in seniority, aged thirty-five, born on the nineteenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Zongyuan; his grandfather was Wang Jingfu; his father is Wang Cong; and his mother is née Zhang. Both his parents are living. He is married to née Li. He ranked sixth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and fifty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lao Yue 勞鉞 (registered under a civilian household in Dehua County, Jiujiang Prefecture, Jiangxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Tingqi, fifth in seniority, aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Lao Shixian; his grandfather was Lao Yonghe; his father is Lao Zhichong (Assistant Instructor); and his mother is née Yu. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Lao Ming, Lao Zhen, Lao Jian, and Lao Zhong; his younger brothers are Lao Yong, Lao Jing, Lao Yao, and Lao Duo. He is married to née Guo. He ranked fifty-ninth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred eightieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Cen 鄭岑 (registered under a civilian household in Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Zigao, second in seniority, aged thirty-five, born on the fourteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Zheng Zongxiang; his grandfather was Zheng Yinhuai; his father is Zheng Xin; and his mother is née Dong. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Zheng Song; his younger brothers are Zheng Yan, Zheng Yue, and Zheng Song. He is married to née Qiu. He ranked eighty-fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
鄭永昌〔貫四川成都府雙流縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字慶夫，行二，年三十五，閏正月二十四日生〕。曾祖毅祥，祖世隆，父理，母凌氏。具慶下，兄永禎，娶胡氏。四川鄉試第二名，會試第二百二十七名。

林雍〔貫福建漳州府龍溪縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字萬容，行六，年三十五，十二月十七日生〕。曾祖均華，祖德貴，父晦暘，母彭氏。慈侍下，兄麟、鈞、鐘、錠、興，弟熈，娶魏氏。福建鄉試第三十六名，會試第二百九十三名。

孔鏞〔貫直隸蘇州府長洲縣儒籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字韶文，行一，年二十八，五月十九日生〕。曾祖克信，祖士完，父友諒〔進士，任知縣〕，前母鍾氏，母宋氏。慈侍下，弟公鍾、公鐸、公銘，娶林氏。應天府鄉試第十六名，會試第二百二十五名。

王鑑〔貫山西太原府太原縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字彦昭，行二，年四十五，十月初十日生〕。曾祖公柔，祖瞻卬，父吉甫，母陳氏。永感下，兄固，弟樽、鉞、銳，娶趙氏。山西鄉試第八名，會試第三百三十三名。
translation_en:
Zheng Yongchang 鄭永昌 [registered in a military household in Shuangliu County 雙流縣, Chengdu Prefecture 成都府, Sichuan 四川; a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Qingfu 慶夫; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-fourth day of the intercalary first month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Yixiang 毅祥, his grandfather was Zheng Shilong 世隆, his father is Zheng Li 理, and his mother is née Ling 凌氏. Both of his parents are living; his elder brother is Yongzhen 永禎, and he is married to née Hu 胡氏. He placed second in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Yong 林雍 [registered in a civilian household in Longxi County 龍溪縣, Zhangzhou Prefecture 漳州府, Fujian 福建; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wanrong 萬容; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the seventeenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Lin Junhua 均華, his grandfather was Lin Degui 德貴, his father was Lin Huiyang 晦暘, and his mother is née Peng 彭氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased; his elder brothers are Lin 麟, Jun 鈞, Zhong 鐘, Ding 錠, and Xing 興, his younger brother is Xi 熈, and he is married to née Wei 魏氏. He placed thirty-sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Kong Yong 孔鏞 [registered in a Confucian scholar household in Changzhou County 長洲縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Zhili 直隸; a County Student (xianxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shaowen 韶文; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the nineteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Kong Kexin 克信, his grandfather was Kong Shiwan 士完, his father was Kong Youliang 友諒 [a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) who served as District Magistrate], his father's former wife was née Zhong 鍾氏, and his mother is née Song 宋氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased; his younger brothers are Gongzhong 公鍾, Gongduo 公鐸, and Gongming 公銘, and he is married to née Lin 林氏. He placed sixteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Jian 王鑑 [registered in a military household in Taiyuan County 太原縣, Taiyuan Prefecture 太原府, Shanxi 山西; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yanzhao 彦昭; second in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-five, born on the tenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Gongrou 公柔, his grandfather was Wang Zhan'ang 瞻卬, his father was Wang Jifu 吉甫, and his mother was née Chen 陳氏. Both of his parents are deceased; his elder brother is Gu 固, his younger brothers are Zun 樽, Yue 鉞, and Rui 銳, and he is married to née Zhao 趙氏. He placed eighth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and three hundred thirty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

上泰〔貫湖廣武昌府江夏縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字志同，行一，年三十，八月二十六日生〕。曾祖同文，祖伯輿〔鹽課提舉〕，父驥，母李氏，繼母張氏。重慶下，弟觀、謙、晉、升。娶甘氏。湖廣鄉試第十名，會試第十三名。

translation_en:
Liu Shu 劉恕 [registered in a civilian household of Yongfeng County 永豐縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Kuanren 寬仁; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight; born on the sixteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Gui'an 貴安, his grandfather Liu Yongjia 永嘉, his father Liu Gongmao 公懋, and his mother Lady Zeng 曾氏. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Xingren 興仁 and Chunren 純仁. He married Lady Xiao 蕭氏, and took as his second wife Lady Deng 鄧氏. He ranked 174th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 149th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shang Tai 上泰 [registered in a military household of Jiangxia County 江夏縣, Wuchang Prefecture 武昌府, Huguang 湖廣; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhitong 志同; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty; born on the twenty-sixth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Shang Tongwen 同文, his grandfather Shang Boyu 伯輿 [Supervisor of a Salt Tax Supervisorate], his father Shang Ji 驥, his mother Lady Li 李氏, and his stepmother Lady Zhang 張氏. Both grandparents and parents are living; his younger brothers are Guan 觀, Qian 謙, Jin 晉, and Sheng 升. He married Lady Gan 甘氏. He ranked 10th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 13th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liang Ju 梁矩 [registered in an artisan household of Panyu County 番禺縣, Guangzhou Prefecture 廣州府, Guangdong 廣東; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shufang 叔方; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine; born on the seventh day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Liang Zongyuan 宗遠, his grandfather Liang Wenxi 文禧, his father Liang Yiming 義名, and his mother Lady Chen 陳氏. His mother is living (his father having died); his elder brothers are Tingyong 廷用 and Tingning 廷寧, and his younger brother is Cheng 成. He married Lady Chen 陳氏, and took as his second wife Lady Gu 顧氏. He ranked 40th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 26th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Cong 馬聰 [registered in a civilian household of Yongxin County 永新縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Tizhe 體哲; seventh in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four; born on the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Ma Qichu 啓初, his grandfather Ma Cheng'an 誠安, his father Ma Xingyu 性愚, and his mother Lady Li 李氏. His mother is living (his father having died); his elder brothers are Mao 懋, Zhi 智, Yi 毅, Ren 仁, Ya 雅, and Shen 慎, and his younger brothers are Zhengyi 正義, Tizhong 體忠, and Tihe 體和. He married Lady Hua 花氏. He ranked 27th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 44th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Liu Ke 劉珂 (registered under a military household in Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shangpei 尚珮; fourth in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-seven, born on the twelfth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Yongbin 用斌, his grandfather was Liu Boyan 伯儼, his father is Liu Wanxiu 萬脩, his legal mother is née Yang 陽, and his birth mother is née Xiao 蕭. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Shangsui 尚璲, and his younger brothers are Shangqi 尚玘, Shangzan 尚瓚, and Shangheng 尚珩. He married née Zhu 朱. He placed twenty-fourth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and fifty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Huan 孫瓛 (registered under a military household in Wuxi County, Changzhou Prefecture, Zhili; Added Student of a Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingyu 廷玉; first in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-five, born on the sixth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Sun Zhong 忠, his grandfather was Sun Long 隆, his father was Sun Shijie 士傑, and his mother is née Zhou 周. His mother is living. His younger brother is Lin 琳. He married née Lu 陸. He placed 116th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and ninety-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Kui 顏夔 (registered under a civilian household in You County, Changsha Prefecture, Huguang; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shiqi 士奇; first in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-two, born on the eighteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Yan Baoqing 寳卿, his grandfather was Yan Shiyong 時用 (Assistant Instructor), his father is Yan Lin 霖 (Instructor), and his mother is née Yu 虞. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Long 龍 and Yi 益. He married née Li 李, and was subsequently betrothed to née Zhang 張. He placed sixty-seventh in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 295th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yu 王豫 (registered under a civilian household in Xiangfu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yongcheng 用誠; third in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-seven, born on the ninth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Jishan 積善, his grandfather was Wang Cheng 成, his father was Wang He 和, and his mother was née Sun 孫. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yi 頤 and Rang 讓. He married née Liu 劉. He placed nineteenth in the Henan Provincial Examination and 163rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

沈聲〔貫浙江嘉興府崇德縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字廷和，行一，年二十七，二月二十四日生〕。曾祖孫；祖泛；父貴〔知州〕，母朱氏。慈侍下。浙江鄉試第九十九名，會試第一百九十八名。

translation_en:
Weng Jing 翁經 (registered in a military household in Luzhou, Sichuan; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zaidao; second in his generation; aged thirty-three, born on the first day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhonghe; his grandfather was Shijing; his father is Ling, his mother was Madam Zhang, and his stepmother is Madam Cheng. Both his father and stepmother are living. He has an elder brother, Huan, and younger brothers, Bin, Jin, and Qi. He is married to Madam Xia. He placed thirteenth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Teng Zuo 滕佐 (registered in a military household in Lan County, Lintao Prefecture, Shaanxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Liangfu; first in his generation; aged thirty-one, born on the seventh day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Renshou; his grandfather was Yunzhong; his father is Yao, and his mother was Madam Gao. His father is living. He has younger brothers, Shen, Wei, and Lun. He is married to Madam Yu. He placed fifteenth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Sheng 沈聲 (registered in a civilian household in Chongde County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tinghe; first in his generation; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-fourth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Sun; his grandfather was Fan; his father was Gui (Department Magistrate), and his mother is Madam Zhu. His mother is living. He placed ninety-ninth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Meng Huai 孟淮 (registered in a civilian household in Boye County, Baoding Prefecture, Zhili; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Zonghai; first in his generation; aged twenty-five, born on the second day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Yuchun (posthumously honored as Right Vice Minister of Revenue); his grandfather was Huan (Prefectural Assistant Prefect, posthumously honored as Right Vice Minister of Revenue); his father is Jian (Left Vice Minister of Revenue), and his mother is Madam Zhang (invested as Lady of Virtue). Both his parents are living. He has younger brothers, Huan, Qi, Ying, and Lian. He is married to Madam Yao. He placed seventy-seventh in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

郁綸〔貫山東濟南府德州軍籍，州學生，治《春秋》，字理之，行二，年三十四，正月二十二日生〕。曾祖顯忠，祖從善，父煥章〔大義千戶〕，母沈氏。重慶下。兄引之，弟宣之。娶顧氏。山東鄉試第十七名，會試第六十名。

湯清〔貫江西吉安府永新縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字汝正，行九，年二十七，九月二十日生〕。曾祖玄圭，祖東寅，父恂如，母劉氏。慈侍下。兄春年、汝猷、汝哲、汝勱、復、補、汝賢、汝勉、汝良。娶劉氏。江西鄉試第一百八十八名，會試第二百七十八名。

蔣瑄〔貫河南開封府鈞州民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字文璽，行二，年三十，四月初十日生〕。曾祖清，祖克明，父成，母李氏。具慶下。兄海，弟温、恭、良。娶馬氏。河南鄉試第六名，會試第一百七十五名。
translation_en:
Yu Lun 郁綸 (courtesy name Lizhi 理之, second in seniority in his generation) was registered in a military household in De Subprefecture 德州, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong 山東. A subprefectural Confucian school student (zhou xuesheng) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), he was thirty-four sui and born on the twenty-second day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Yu Xianzhong 郁顯忠, his grandfather was Yu Congshan 郁從善, his father was Yu Huanzhang 郁煥章 (Grand Righteousness Battalion Commander [Dayi qianhu] [?]), and his mother was Lady Shen 沈氏. Both his parents and grandparents were living (chongqing xia). He had an elder brother, Yinzhi 引之, and a younger brother, Xuanzhi 宣之, and he was married to Lady Gu 顧氏. He placed seventeenth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and sixtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Rang 黃讓 (courtesy name Yongxun 用遜, second in seniority in his generation) was registered in a civilian household in Wuhu County 蕪湖縣, Taiping Prefecture 太平府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸). A county Confucian school student (xian xuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), he was thirty-three sui and born on the eighteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Huang Chengyi 黃誠一, his grandfather was Huang Rongqing 黃榮卿, his father was Huang Xin 黃信, and his mother was Lady Hu 胡氏. His mother was living (cishi xia). He had an elder brother, Jie 詰, and was married to Lady Xing 邢氏. He placed thirty-sixth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and seventy-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Qing 湯清 (courtesy name Ruzheng 汝正, ninth in seniority in his generation) was registered in a civilian household in Yongxin County 永新縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西. A county Confucian school student (xian xuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), he was twenty-seven sui and born on the twentieth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Tang Xuangui 湯玄圭, his grandfather was Tang Dongyin 湯東寅, his father was Tang Xunru 湯恂如, and his mother was Lady Liu 劉氏. His mother was living (cishi xia). He had elder brothers Chunnian 春年, Ruyou 汝猷, Ruzhe 汝哲, Rumai 汝勱, Fu 復, Bu 補, Ruxian 汝賢, Rumian 汝勉, and Ruliang 汝良, and was married to Lady Liu 劉氏. He placed 188th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 278th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Xuan 蔣瑄 (courtesy name Wenxi 文璽, second in seniority in his generation) was registered in a civilian household in Jun Subprefecture 鈞州, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南. A Directorate of Education student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing), he was thirty sui and born on the tenth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Jiang Qing 蔣清, his grandfather was Jiang Keming 蔣克明, his father was Jiang Cheng 蔣成, and his mother was Lady Li 李氏. Both his parents were living (juqing xia). He had an elder brother, Hai 海, and younger brothers Wen 温, Gong 恭, and Liang 良, and he was married to Lady Ma 馬氏. He placed sixth in the Henan Provincial Examination and 175th in the Metropolitan Examination.

黎庸
貫交阯交阯府清威縣民籍　儒士

貫直隸應天府江寧縣富戶籍江西吉水縣人　府學生
治書經字□□行一年三十一正月十七日生
曾祖仲淵〔贈左副都御史〕　祖□錫〔□□左副都御史〕　伯通〔太子少保右都御史〕　父遵　母曾氏　繼母王氏

punctuated:
林孔仁〔貫福建□州府懷安縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字孔仁，行六，年三十七，十月初二日生〕。曾祖以源，祖士完，父彥庸，母何氏。具慶下，兄孔明，娶鄭氏。福建鄉試第六十七名，會試第二百六十八名。

劉謨〔貫江西吉安府安福縣民籍，縣學生，治《春秋》，字應咨，行三，年二十七，六月十六日生〕。曾祖崇高，祖偕樂，父從誠，母曾氏。具慶下，兄薦、莊，弟典、戢、光、平，娶謝氏。江西鄉試第一百七十五名，會試第一百四十一名。

黎庸〔貫交阯交州府清威縣民籍，儒士，治《詩經》，字通理，行一，年三十，十月二十日生〕。曾祖世亨〔知府〕，祖春〔州判〕，父敏德，母胡氏。具慶下，未娶。順天府鄉試第五名，會試第八十名。

羅淮〔貫直隸應天府江寧縣富戶籍，江西吉水縣人，府學生，治《書經》，字澗□，行一，年三十一，正月十七日生〕。曾祖仲淵〔贈左副都御史〕，祖三錫〔贈右副都御史〕，伯通〔太子少保、右都御史〕，父遵，母賈氏，繼母王氏。嚴侍下，弟濱、洪，娶周氏。應天府鄉試第五十二名，會試第一百四十名。
translation_en:
Lin Kongren 林孔仁 (registered in a civilian household of Huai'an County, [Fuzhou] Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Kongren; sixth in his generation; aged thirty-seven, born on the second day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Lin Yiyuan, his grandfather was Lin Shiwan, his father is Lin Yanyong, and his mother is née He. Both of his parents are living; his elder brother is Kongming; he married née Zheng. He placed sixty-seventh in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Mo 劉謨 (registered in a civilian household of Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; County School Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Yingzi; third in his generation; aged twenty-seven, born on the sixteenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Chonggao, his grandfather was Liu Jiele, his father is Liu Congcheng, and his mother is née Zeng. Both of his parents are living; his elder brothers are Jian and Zhuang; his younger brothers are Dian, Ji, Guang, and Ping; he married née Xie. He placed one hundred seventy-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yong 黎庸 (Lê Dung, registered in a civilian household of Qingwei County [Thanh Oai], Jiaozhou Prefecture, Jiaozhi; Confucian Scholar; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tongli; first in his generation; aged thirty, born on the twentieth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Li Shiheng (Prefect), his grandfather was Li Chun (Assistant Subprefect), his father is Li Minde, and his mother is née Hu. Both of his parents are living; he is unmarried. He placed fifth in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and eightieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Luo Huai 羅淮 (registered in a wealthy household of Jiangning County, Yingtian Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area, originally from Jishui County, Jiangxi; Prefectural School Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Jian[…]; first in his generation; aged thirty-one, born on the seventeenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Luo Zhongyuan (posthumously honoured as Left Vice Censor-in-chief), his grandfather was Luo Sanxi (posthumously honoured as Right Vice Censor-in-chief), his paternal uncle is Luo Tong (Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Right Censor-in-chief), his father is Luo Zun, his mother was née Jia, and his stepmother is née Wang. His father is living; his younger brothers are Bin and Hong; he married née Zhou. He placed fifty-second in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and one hundred fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

王績〔貫直隸松江府華亭縣醫籍，太醫院醫生，治《書經》，字功偉，行一，年二十五，三月三十日生〕。曾祖九山，祖敏，父拳〔醫士〕，母徐氏。具慶下。娶柳氏。順天府鄉試第一百二十六名，會試第一百二十一名。

于琇〔貫河南開封府通許縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字廷玉，行二，年二十八，八月二十日生〕。曾祖成，祖深，父傑〔訓導〕，前母竇氏，母范氏。具慶下。兄瓚。娶劉氏。河南鄉試第一名，會試第二百五十三名。

李瓘〔貫河南河南府澠池縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字叔玉，行三，年三十一，三月十八日生〕。曾祖仲文，祖原道，父吉〔紀善〕，前母張氏，母邢氏。嚴侍下。兄瑀、璘，弟琰。娶高氏。河南鄉試第三十三名，會試第二百四十七名。

章律〔貫直隸蘇州府常熟縣官籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字鳴鳳，行四，年二十七，五月初九日生〕。曾祖日敬，祖煥文，父珪〔前監察御史〕，前母陸氏，母李氏。重慶下。兄儀〔訓導〕、表〔行人司行人〕、格〔工部主事〕、度〔貢士〕，弟楷。娶王氏。應天府鄉試第七十名，會試第五十八名。
translation_en:
Wang Ji 王績 [registered in a physician household of Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Directly Attached (Zhili); Medical Student of the Imperial Academy of Medicine; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Gongwei; seniority first; age twenty-five, born on the thirtieth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Jiushan; his grandfather was Wang Min; his father is Wang Quan [Medical Practitioner]; and his mother is née Xu. Both parents are living. He married née Liu. He placed 126th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 121st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Xiu 于琇 [registered in a commoner household of Tongxu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; County Confucian Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Tingyu; seniority second; age twenty-eight, born on the twentieth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Yu Cheng; his grandfather was Yu Shen; his father is Yu Jie [Assistant Instructor]; his father's deceased first wife was née Dou; and his mother is née Fan. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Yu Zan. He married née Liu. He placed 1st in the Henan Provincial Examination and 253rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Guan 李瓘 [registered in a commoner household of Mianchi County, Henan Prefecture, Henan; County Confucian Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shuyu; seniority third; age thirty-one, born on the eighteenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Li Zhongwen; his grandfather was Li Yuandao; his father is Li Ji [Princely Mentor]; his father's deceased first wife was née Zhang; and his mother was née Xing. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brothers are Li Yu and Li Lin, and his younger brother is Li Yan. He married née Gao. He placed 33rd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 247th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Lü 章律 [registered in an official household of Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Directly Attached (Zhili); County Confucian Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Mingfeng; seniority fourth; age twenty-seven, born on the ninth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Rijing; his grandfather is Zhang Huanwen; his father is Zhang Gui [former Investigating Censor]; his father's deceased first wife was née Lu; and his mother is née Li. Both grandparents and parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Yi [Assistant Instructor], Zhang Biao [Messenger in the Messenger Office], Zhang Ge [Secretary in the Ministry of Works], and Zhang Du [Tribute Student (gongshi)], and his younger brother is Zhang Kai. He married née Wang. He placed 70th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 58th in the Metropolitan Examination.

楊瑄〔貫江西南昌府豐城縣，民籍，府學增廣生，治《易經》，字廷獻，行一，年三十，六月十四日生〕。曾祖回仲，祖名高，父子榮〔教諭〕，母周氏，繼母塗氏。具慶下，弟玖，妻計氏。江西鄉試第一百四十四名，會試第一百八十九名。
王重〔貫江西吉安府安福縣，民籍，縣學增廣生，治《春秋》，字式鈞，行十六，年二十九，十月十二日生〕。曾祖所冲，祖次學，父瀘淵，嫡母鄧氏，母劉氏。具慶下，兄式銀，弟式鎰，娶姚氏。江西鄉試第三十九名，會試第二百六名。
金澤〔貫浙江紹興府山陰縣，民籍，□□□生，治《詩經》，字用文，行一，年三十九，七月二十八日生〕。曾祖仁四，祖永華，父俊，母陸氏。慈侍下，弟湜，娶趙氏。浙江鄉試第八十三名，會試第一百六名。
王用〔貫江西吉安府泰和縣，□□□□□生，治《易經》，字廷用，行□，□□□□□初二日生〕。曾祖以文，祖□□，父□□〔□□□〕，母蕭氏。慈侍下，娶易氏。江西鄉試第一百三名，會試第一百十三名。
translation_en:
Yang Xuan 楊瑄 is registered in Fengcheng County 豐城縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西, in a civilian household, and is anAdded Student (zengguang sheng) of the Prefectural School; he specializes in the Book of Changes (Yijing), his courtesy name is Tingxian 廷獻, he is first in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty years old, born on the fourteenth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Yang Huizhong 楊回仲, his grandfather was Yang Minggao 楊名高, his father is Yang Zirong 楊子榮 (Instructor [jiaoyu]), his mother was née Zhou 周氏, and his stepmother is née Tu 塗氏. Both his father and stepmother are living; his younger brother is Yang Jiu 楊玖, and his wife is née Ji 計氏. He placed 144th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 189th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zhong 王重 is registered in Anfu County 安福縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi, in a civilian household, and is an Added Student of the County School; he specializes in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), his courtesy name is Shijun 式鈞, he is sixteenth in seniority among his male cousins, and he is twenty-nine years old, born on the twelfth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Wang Suochong 王所冲, his grandfather was Wang Cixue 王次學, his father is Wang Luyuan 王瀘淵, his father's principal wife is née Deng 鄧氏, and his birth mother is née Liu 劉氏. Both parents are living; his elder brother is Wang Shiyin 王式銀, his younger brother is Wang Shiyi 王式鎰, and he married née Yao 姚氏. He placed 39th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 206th in the Metropolitan Examination.

謝瑀，貫福建福州府閩清縣軍籍，縣學增廣生，治《禮記》，字叔和，行二，年二十，二月十五日生。曾祖寶；祖斌；父漢傑，母金氏。具慶下。兄瓛，弟玟、珩。娶楊氏。福建鄉試第六名，會試第二百九十二名。
許顒，貫河南彰德府安陽縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字孟敬，行五十三，二十三，四月二十一日生。曾祖元幹〔元禮儀院博士〕；祖伯厚〔縣丞〕；父坦，母皇甫氏，繼母王氏。具慶下。弟昂、顯。娶李氏。河南鄉試第十二名，會試第九十九名。
王魯，貫應天府溧水縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字希曾，行三十三，二十八，正月二十九日生。曾祖德明〔主簿〕；祖伯忠；父文奎，母周氏，繼母陳氏、端氏。具慶下。兄佐、弼，弟聰、明、俊、述、文、器、辨、謹、孝。娶李氏。應天府鄉試第五十七名，會試第二百四十三名。
劉濟，貫河南懷慶府河內縣民籍，府學增廣生，治《書經》，字彥霖，行二，年二十一，十月二十七日生。曾祖太本；祖鵬義；父鐸〔教諭〕，母李氏。慈侍下。兄潤，弟瀚、濩。娉王氏。河南鄉試第六名，會試第二百九十七名。
translation_en:
Xie Yu 謝瑀, registered under a military household in Minqing County 閩清縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建, was an added student (zengguang sheng) of the county school who specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji). His courtesy name was Shuhe 叔和, he was the second son in his family line, and he was twenty sui old, born on the fifteenth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Xie Bao 謝寶, his grandfather was Xie Bin 謝斌, his father is Xie Hanjie 謝漢傑, and his mother is née Jin 金氏. Both his parents are living. He has an elder brother, Xie Huan 謝瓛, and younger brothers, Xie Min 謝玟 and Xie Heng 謝珩; he married née Yang 楊氏. He placed sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Yong 許顒, registered under a civilian household in Anyang County 安陽縣, Zhangde Prefecture 彰德府, Henan 河南, was a student of the county school who specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name was Mengjing 孟敬, he was the fifty-third son in his lineage, and he was twenty-three sui old, born on the twenty-first day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Xu Yuangan 許元幹 (an Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices under the Yuan dynasty), his grandfather was Xu Bohou 許伯厚 (a Vice Magistrate), his father is Xu Tan 許坦, his mother was née Huangfu 皇甫氏, and his stepmother is née Wang 王氏. His father and stepmother are both living. He has younger brothers, Xu Ang 許昂 and Xu Xian 許顯; he married née Li 李氏. He placed twelfth in the Henan Provincial Examination and ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Lu 王魯, registered under a civilian household in Lishui County 溧水縣, Yingtian Prefecture 應天府, was a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) who specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His courtesy name was Xizeng 希曾, he was the thirty-third son in his lineage, and he was twenty-eight sui old, born on the twenty-ninth day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Wang Deming 王德明 (an Assistant Magistrate), his grandfather was Wang Bozhong 王伯忠, his father is Wang Wenkui 王文奎, his mother was née Zhou 周氏, and his stepmothers were née Chen 陳氏 and née Duan 端氏. His father and stepmother are living. He has elder brothers, Wang Zuo 王佐 and Wang Bi 王弼, and younger brothers, Wang Cong 王聰, Wang Ming 王明, Wang Jun 王俊, Wang Shu 王述, Wang Wen 王文, Wang Qi 王器, Wang Bian 王辨, Wang Jin 王謹, and Wang Xiao 王孝; he married née Li 李氏. He placed fifty-seventh in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Ji 劉濟, registered under a civilian household in Henei County 河內縣, Huaiqing Prefecture 懷慶府, Henan 河南, was an added student (zengguang sheng) of the prefectural school who specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His courtesy name was Yanlin 彥霖, he was the second son in his family line, and he was twenty-one sui old, born on the twenty-seventh day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Liu Taiben 劉太本, his grandfather was Liu Pengyi 劉鵬義, his father was Liu Duo 劉鐸 (a County Director of Studies), and his mother is née Li 李氏. His mother is living. He has an elder brother, Liu Run 劉潤, and younger brothers, Liu Han 劉瀚 and Liu Huo 劉濩; he is betrothed to née Wang 王氏. He placed sixth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Zong 林宗 (registered in Huai'an County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, under a commoner household; a County School Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Weizheng, first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-one, born on the fifteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Lin Zijing, his grandfather was Lin Fengsheng, his father was Lin Han, and his mother is née Pan. His mother is living while his father is deceased. He has a younger brother, Lin Ding. He is married to a woman née Yuan. He ranked ninety-first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and seventy-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Chang 李常 (registered in Guiping County, Xunzhou Prefecture, Guangxi, under a commoner household; an Added Student of the Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Hengchang, second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the eighteenth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Li Wenyou, his grandfather was Li Ruchen, his father is Li Deyu, and his mother is née Chen. Both of his parents are living. He has an elder brother, Li Hengsheng, and younger brothers, Li Henghuan, Li Hengtai, and Li Hengguan. He is married to a woman née Quan. He ranked thirteenth in the Guangxi Provincial Examination and sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Shen 朱紳 (registered in the Hezhou Guard Military-cum-Civilian Command, Shaanxi, under a military household; a National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Dayong, first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the eleventh day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Qi, his grandfather was Zhu Tong, his father is Zhu Wen, his mother was née Zhang, and his stepmother is née Wang. Both of his parents are living. He has younger brothers, Zhu Shou and Zhu Fu. He is married to a woman née Xu. He ranked sixteenth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Pu 李溥 (registered in Changyuan County, Daming Prefecture, Zhili, under a military household; a National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Daji, third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-third day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Li Wenrui, his grandfather was Li Shiyuan, his father is Li Chun [Vice Commissioner of the Gudi Saltern], and his mother is née Wang. Both of his parents are living. 桂茂之〔貫四川成都府成都縣軍籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字廷秀，行一，年二十五，正月十五日生〕。曾祖伯華；祖文禮；父廣；叔山〔戶部主事〕；母余氏。具慶下。弟蕃之、英之、華之、蕙之、蘭之。娶何氏。四川鄉試第四十三名，會試第一百十二名。

鄧廷瓚〔貫湖廣岳州府巴陵縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字宗器，行一，年二十五，七月二十六日生〕。曾祖成；祖華；父冕〔縣學訓導〕；嫡母陳氏、楚氏；生母戴氏。慈侍下。弟廷珪、廷璋。娶潘氏。湖廣鄉試□□□□□名，會試□□□□□名。
translation_en:
Feng Yun 馮韻 [registered under a civilian household in Fuliang County, Raozhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; an Added Student at the County School; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Weihe; ninth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five; born on the thirtieth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Feng Fuzhi; his grandfather was Feng Yu [posthumously honored as Investigating Censor]; his father is Feng Cheng [Surveillance Commissioner of Huguang]; and his mother is née Min [invested as Child Nurturess]. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Feng Shao. He is married to a woman née Dai. He placed 147th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 283rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Zheng 周正 [registered under a civilian household in Nanchang County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; an Added Student at the Prefectural School; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zhiqing; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven; born on the twenty-fourth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Tongguang; his grandfather was Zhou Yanxiu; his father is Zhou Zhiya; and his mother was née Zhu. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brother is Zhou Wenzheng, and his younger brother is Zhou Xuezheng. He is married to a woman née Xiong. He placed 149th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 59th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gui Maozhi 桂茂之 [registered under a military household in Chengdu County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; a County School Student; specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Tingxiu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five; born on the fifteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Gui Bohua; his grandfather was Gui Wenli; his father is Gui Guang; his paternal uncle is Gui Shan [Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue]; and his mother is née Yu. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Gui Fanzhi, Gui Yingzhi, Gui Huazhi, Gui Huizhi, and Gui Lanzhi. He is married to a woman née He. He placed 43rd in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 112th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Deng Tingzan 鄧廷瓚 [registered under a military household in Baling County, Yuezhou Prefecture, Huguang; a Student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zongqi; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five; born on the twenty-sixth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Deng Cheng; his grandfather was Deng Hua; his father was Deng Mian [Assistant Instructor of a County School]; his legal mothers were née Chen and née Chu; and his birth mother is née Dai. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His younger brothers are Deng Tinggui and Deng Tingzhang. He is married to a woman née Pan. He placed [5 illegible characters] in the Huguang Provincial Examination and [5 illegible characters] in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
聊讓〔貫陝西肅府儀衛司軍籍，直隸巢縣人，蘭縣學軍生，治《詩經》，字公遜，行一，年三十六，七月初九日生〕。曾祖興隆，祖德輔，父旺，母高氏。慈侍下。娶何氏，繼娶張氏。陝西鄉試第三十名，會試第三百四十六名。

李稷〔貫四川重慶府合州民籍，州學增廣生，治《春秋》，字廷貴，行一，年三十，十月三十日生〕。曾祖茂山，祖太和，父添常，母張氏。永感下。弟相。娶周氏。四川鄉試第三十九名，會試第二百六十八名。

吳瑀〔貫直隸淮安府山陽縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字德潤，行一，年二十九，十二月初二日生〕。曾祖誠，祖子安，父聚，母張氏。具慶下。弟瑄、瓛、琇、璋、瑛。娶張氏。應天府鄉試第五十名，會試第二十五名。

李巽〔貫順天府宛平縣官籍，國子生，治《易經》，字用經，行四，年三十，五月初六日生〕。曾祖師曾〔贈禮部左侍郎〕，祖嘉〔禮部左侍郎〕，伯栗〔贈南京通政司左參議〕，父直，母甄氏。具慶下。從兄震〔南京通政司左參議〕、謙、泰，弟頤、豫、升。娶徐氏。順天府鄉試第八十三名，會試第三百十名。
translation_en:
Liao Rang 聊讓 (registered under a military household of the Ceremonial Guard of the Princedom of Su in Shaanxi, a native of Chao County in the Directly Attached Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a military student at the Lan County School specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Gongxun 公遜; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the ninth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Liao Xinglong 興隆, his grandfather was Liao Defu 德輔, his father was Liao Wang 旺, and his mother is née Gao 高氏. His mother is living (his father having passed away). He married née He 何氏, and took née Zhang 張氏 as his second wife. He placed 30th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 346th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Ji 李稷 (registered under a civilian household in He Subprefecture, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; an added student at the Subprefectural School specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Tinggui 廷貴; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the thirtieth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Li Maoshan 茂山, his grandfather was Li Taihe 太和, his father was Li Tianchang 添常, and his mother was née Zhang 張氏. Both of his parents have passed away. His younger brother is Li Xiang 相. He married née Zhou 周氏. He placed 39th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 268th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Yu 吳瑀 (registered under a civilian household in Shanyang County, Huai'an Prefecture in the Directly Attached Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a student of the Directorate of Education [Guozisheng] specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Derun 德潤; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the second day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Wu Cheng 誠, his grandfather was Wu Zi'an 子安, his father is Wu Ju 聚, and his mother is née Zhang 張氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Wu Xuan 瑄, Wu Huan 瓛, Wu Xiu 琇, Wu Zhang 璋, and Wu Ying 瑛. He married née Zhang 張氏. He placed 50th in the Yingtian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and 25th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Xun 李巽 (registered under an official household in Wanping County, Shuntian Prefecture; a student of the Directorate of Education [Guozisheng] specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yongjing 用經; fourth in seniority among his brothers and cousins; aged thirty, born on the sixth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Li Shizeng 師曾 (posthumously granted the title of Left Vice Minister of Rites), his grandfather was Li Jia 嘉 (Left Vice Minister of Rites), his paternal elder uncle was Li Li 栗 (posthumously granted the title of Left Assistant Commissioner in the Office of Transmission in Nanjing), his father is Li Zhi 直, and his mother is née Zhen 甄氏. Both of his parents are living. His older paternal cousins are Li Zhen 震 (Left Assistant Commissioner in the Office of Transmission in Nanjing), Li Qian 謙, and Li Tai 泰, and his younger brothers are Li Yi 頤, Li Yu 豫, and Li Sheng 升. He married née Xu 徐氏. He placed 83rd in the Shuntian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and 310th in the Metropolitan Examination.
