阮勤〔貫交阯多翼縣，民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字必成，行一，年三十二，十二月初二日生〕。曾祖文，祖泰，父河〔典史〕，母吳氏，繼母万氏。慈侍下。娶周氏。順天府鄉試第三十七名，會試第一百二十七名。

何玘〔貫河南汝寧府羅山縣，民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字廷用，行一，年三十，十二月十三日生〕。曾祖勝祖，祖必貴，父逵〔訓導〕，母潘氏。具慶下。弟珣、章。娶陳氏，繼娶索氏。河南鄉試第二十九名，會試第三百八名。
translation_en:
Yang Shao 楊紹 [registered as a commoner of Xianning County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shaozong; second in generational seniority; age thirty-four, born on the twenty-third day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Xiu; his grandfather was Yang Dexin [posthumously honored as Guard Registrar]; his father was Yang Jingfang [Guard Registrar]; and his mother is Madam Yuan [invested as Child-Nurturess]. His mother is living. He has an elder brother, Yang Ji, and a younger brother, Yang Xu; he is married to Madam Liu. He placed seventh in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and three hundred forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Yinzhi 劉寅之 [registered in a Confucian scholar household of Yongxin County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zhujing; second in generational seniority; age thirty-nine, born on the eighth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Xisuo; his grandfather was Liu Yuanjie; his father was Liu Mao [invested as Historiographer]; his principal mother was Madam Yang [invested as Child-Nurturess]; and his birth mother is Madam Liu [invested as Child-Nurturess]. His mother is living. He has an elder brother, Liu Dingzhi [Librarian of the Left Directorate of Education concurrently serving as Expositor-in-waiting], and younger brothers Liu Anzhi and Liu Yizhi; he married Madam Xie, and after her death married Madam Huang. He placed fourteenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and eighty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ruan Qin 阮勤 [registered as a commoner of Duoyi County, Jiaozhi; National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Bicheng; first in generational seniority; age thirty-two, born on the second day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Ruan Wen; his grandfather was Ruan Tai; his father was Ruan He [Jail Warden]; his mother was Madam Wu; and his stepmother is Madam Mo. His mother is living. He is married to Madam Zhou. He placed thirty-seventh in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Qi 何玘 [registered as a commoner of Luoshan County, Runing Prefecture, Henan; National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Tingyong; first in generational seniority; age thirty, born on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was He Shengzu; his grandfather was He Bigui; his father is He Kui [Assistant Instructor]; and his mother is Madam Pan. Both of his parents are living. He has younger brothers He Xun and He Zhang; he married Madam Chen, and after her death married Madam Suo. He placed twenty-ninth in the Henan Provincial Examination and three hundred eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

呂恕，貫直隸河間府故城縣民籍，太學生。治《書經》，字希仁，行一，年二十四，七月二十七日生。曾祖順，祖臻〔主簿〕，父敬，母劉氏。慈侍下，兄忠，娶李氏。順天府鄉試第十八名，會試第二百九十名。

蔣敵，貫應天府江寧縣醫籍，直隸丹徒縣人，醫生。治《詩經》，字宗仁，行二，年三十二，九月十六日生。曾祖義甫，祖子中，父彥升〔御醫，贈戶部主事〕，母周氏〔封太安人〕。慈侍下，兄敷〔戶部主事〕，弟敘，娶孫氏。順天府鄉試第一百十三名，會試第四十六名。

楊璧，貫直隸太平府當塗縣軍籍，府學生。治《詩經》，字應奎，行一，年三十，十月初八日生。曾祖景山，祖名達，父恭〔典史〕，母王氏。具慶下，弟文盛，娶錢氏。應天府鄉試第一百四十八名，會試第二百十八名。
translation_en:
Lü Shu 呂恕 is registered in a civilian household in Gucheng County, Hejian Prefecture, Directly Attached [to the capital] (Zhili), and is a student of the National University (Taixue sheng). He specializes in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); his courtesy name is Xiren, he is the first in seniority among his brothers, and he is twenty-four sui, born on the twenty-seventh day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Lü Shun, his grandfather was Lü Zhen (Assistant Magistrate), his father was Lü Jing, and his mother is née Liu. His mother is living; his elder brother is Lü Zhong, and he is married to a woman née Li. He placed eighteenth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and two hundred ninetieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zuo Yuan 左源 is registered in a civilian household in Ji County, Weihui Prefecture, Henan, and is a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozi sheng). He specializes in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); his courtesy name is Daben, he is the third in seniority among his brothers, and he is forty sui, born on the second day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Zuo Fu, his grandfather was Zuo De, his father is Zuo Gui, and his mother is née Liu. Both of his parents are living; his elder brothers are Zuo Da and Zuo Qing, his younger brothers are Zuo Dashan, Zuo Daheng, and Zuo Da'an, and he is married to a woman née Wang. He placed forty-sixth in the Henan Provincial Examination and eighty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Di 蔣敵 is registered in a medical household in Jiangning County, Yingtian Prefecture, is a native of Dantu County, Directly Attached [to the southern capital] (Zhili), and is a Medical Student (yisheng). He specializes in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); his courtesy name is Zongren, he is the second in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-two sui, born on the sixteenth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Jiang Yifu, his grandfather was Jiang Zizhong, his father was Jiang Yansheng ( Imperial Physician, posthumously honored as Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue), and his mother is née Zhou (invested as Grand Mistress of Peace). His mother is living; his elder brother is Jiang Fu (Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue), his younger brother is Jiang Xu, and he is married to a woman née Sun. He placed one hundred thirteenth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Bi 楊璧 is registered in a military household in Dangtu County, Taiping Prefecture, Directly Attached [to the southern capital] (Zhili), and is a Prefectural Student (fuxue sheng). He specializes in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); his courtesy name is Yingkui, he is the first in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty sui, born on the eighth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Yang Jingshan, his grandfather was Yang Mingda, his father is Yang Gong (Unclassified Jail Warden), and his mother is née Wang. Both of his parents are living; his younger brother is Yang Wensheng, and he is married to a woman née Qian. He placed one hundred forty-eighth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and two hundred eighteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Li Jingmeng 李景孟 (registered in a civilian household of Haiyan County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a prefectural student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zonghao; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the fifth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Yuanbai (Vice Supervisor of an Area Command under the Yuan dynasty); his grandfather was Yancheng; his father is Jiheng; and his mother is née Zong. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Jingfu and Jinggao, and his younger brother is Jingfu. He married née Pu, and remarried née Xiao. He placed 29th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 288th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qin Qi 秦玘 (registered in a civilian household of Jizhou, Shuntian Prefecture; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Boyu; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-sixth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Jiucheng; his grandfather was Ding (Usher in the Court of State Ceremonial); his father is Zhun (Police Chief); and his mother is née Li. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Cong, and his younger brother is Xuan. He married née Zhang. He placed 55th in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and 329th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Long 曹隆 (registered in a military household of Xingning County, Chenzhou, Huguang; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Bangsheng; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the seventeenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Rusen; his grandfather is Zongren; his father is Qiming; and his mother is née Luo. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Fu, Kang, and Zhou. He married née [? surname omitted]. He placed 100th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 325th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Peng Sheng 彭盛 (registered in a civilian household of Qingjiang County, Linjiang Prefecture, Jiangxi; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Yongchang; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the twenty-third day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Shangxian; his grandfather was Chengde; his father was Yinbo; and his mother was née Xu. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yongnian and Yongsheng. He married née Nie. He placed 10th in the Yingtian Provincial Examination and 23rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Feng Ding 馮定 (courtesy name Shiding 士定, third in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the tenth day of the tenth month) was a native of Wu County 吳縣 in the Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸) registered as a military artisan under the Embroidered Uniform Guard (Jinyiwei 錦衣衛), and a Student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng 國子生) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing 易經). His great-grandfather was Feng Fuqing 福慶, his grandfather was Feng Guhua 谷華, his father was Feng Yingzhen 應禎, and his mother was née Qin 秦氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Feng Hong 宏 and Feng Ning 寧, his younger brothers are Feng Kuan 寛 and Feng Wan 完, and he is married to née Zhang 張氏. He placed 210th in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and 22nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Yuan 何淵 (courtesy name Youben 有本, third in seniority, aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-eighth day of the ninth month) was registered in a civilian household of Ba County 巴縣 in Baoning Prefecture 保寧府, Sichuan 四川, and was a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing 書經). His great-grandfather was He Wenkui 文奎, his grandfather was He Tingshu 廷恕, his father was He Sheng 昇 (County Director of Studies [Jiaoyu 教諭]), and his mother was née Li 李氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are He Pu 溥 and He Qing 清, his younger brothers are He Han 漢 and He Run 潤, and he is married to née Xiang 向氏. He placed 17th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 74th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Rang 吳讓 (courtesy name Kerang 克讓, second in seniority, aged forty-two, born on the fourth day of the fourth month) was registered in a civilian household of Nanhai County 南海縣 in Guangzhou Prefecture 廣州府, Guangdong 廣東, and was a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Wu Wenbing 文秉, his grandfather was Wu Guangcheng 廣成, his father was Wu Zongmin 宗敏, and his mother was née Chen 陳氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Wu Dang 讜, and he is married to née He 何氏. He placed 2nd in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 145th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shi Zhen 史珍 (courtesy name Tingyu 廷玉, fourth in seniority, aged thirty-five, born on the twentieth day of the sixth month) was registered in a medical household of Dehua County 德化縣 in Jiujiang Prefecture 九江府, Jiangxi 江西, and was a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing 詩經). His great-grandfather was Shi Zhifu 直甫 (Prefectural Director of Studies [Jiaoshou 教授] under the Yuan dynasty), his grandfather was Shi Xucheng 虚誠 (Prefectural Medical Instructor [Xunke 訓科]), his father was Shi Zhong 中 (Right Administration Vice Commissioner [You Canzheng 右參政] of the Shaanxi 陝西 Provincial Administration Commission), his principal mother was née Chen 陳氏, and his birth mother was née Sun 孫氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Shi Huan 瓛 (Superior Medical Officer [Zhengke 正科]), Shi Jie 玠, and Shi Qi 琦 (Guard Registrar [Wei Jingli 衛經歷]), and he is married to née Meng 孟氏. He placed 101st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 212th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Chen 孫忱 [registered in Cixi County 慈谿縣, Ningbo Prefecture 寧波府, Zhejiang 浙江, under civilian household status; National University Student (guozisheng); specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Chengzhi 誠之; fifth in seniority; aged forty-six; born on the twenty-second day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Sun Liwu 孫理五; his grandfather was Sun Yinzang 孫尹臧; his father was Sun Fuying 孫服膺; and his mother was née Ge 葛氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brother is Sun Kai 孫愷. He married a woman née Gu 顧氏, and subsequently married a woman née Zhu 朱氏. He placed fourth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shui Huan 水桓 [registered in Yin County 鄞縣, Ningbo Prefecture 寧波府, Zhejiang 浙江, under civilian household status; National University Student (guozisheng); specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Tinggui 廷圭; first in seniority; aged forty-six; born on the seventeenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Shui Xianzhi 水先之 [Pacification Commissioner (xuanwei shi) under the Yuan dynasty]; his grandfather was Shui Hai 水海; his father was Shui Lian 水廉 [Assistant Magistrate (xiancheng)]; his mother was née Zhu 朱氏; and his stepmother was née Dai 戴氏. He placed tenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and three hundred twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Qi 張岐 [registered in Xingji County 興濟縣, Hejian Prefecture 河間府, Zhili 直隸, under military household status; National University Student (guozisheng); specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Laifeng 來鳳; second in seniority; aged thirty; born on the twelfth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Xixin 張希信; his grandfather was Zhang Di 張迪 [Prefectural Administrative Clerk (fu zhishi)]; his father is Zhang Jin 張縉 [Instructor (jiaoyu)]; and his mother is née Lu 逯氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Xing 張興 [General of the Embroidered Uniform Guard (jinyi jiangjun)] and Zhang Yong 張永; his younger brothers are Zhang Lin 張嶙, Zhang Luan 張巒, and Zhang Xun 張峋. He married a woman née Chu 儲氏. He placed thirteenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Yuan 董淵 [registered in Lingshou County 靈壽縣, Zhending Prefecture 真定府, Zhili 直隸, under military household status; National University Student (guozisheng); specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zongben 宗本; third in seniority; aged thirty-two; born on the fifth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Dong Shi'en 董世恩; his grandfather was Dong Ci 董賜; his paternal elder uncle was Dong Zheng 董正 [Assistant Magistrate (xiancheng)]; his father was Dong Duan 董端; and his mother is née Li 李氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Dong Jun 董俊 and Dong Renjie 董人傑 [Tribute Student / Metropolitan Examination qualifier (gongshi)]; his younger brother is Dong Wei 董偉. He married a woman née Ji 吉氏. He placed twenty-fifth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Nie Yuan 聶元 (registered in a civilian household of Fengcheng County 豐城縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, [Jiangxi] [□□]; Added Student of the County School; specializing in [the Spring and Autumn Annals?] [□□史]; courtesy name Cunshan 存善; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the nineteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Nie Yanbin 彥彬; his grandfather was Nie Zikang 子𧆑; his father is Nie Shizhe 仕哲; his mother was Lady Chen 陳氏, and his stepmother is Lady Lü 呂氏. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Nie Kai 凱, Nie Cheng 承, and Nie Ji 繼. He is married to Lady Xiong 熊氏. He placed fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred eighty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Jie 林傑 (registered in a civilian household of Qiongshan County 瓊山縣, Qiongzhou Prefecture 瓊州府, Guangdong 廣東; Student of the County School; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingbin 廷賓; second in seniority; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Lin Yicheng 彝承; his grandfather was Lin Youshou 有壽; his father is Lin Xiangui 賢貴; his mother is Lady Liang 梁氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Lin Jun 俊, and his younger brother is Lin Kan 侃. He is married to Lady Wang 王氏. He placed second in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Gan 趙敢 (registered in a civilian household of Wujin County 武進縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸]; Student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Shucheng 叔成; third in seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the fifteenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Zhao Yizhi 宜質; his grandfather was Zhao Yanqing 彥清; his paternal uncle was Zhao Minyuan 敏遠, Battalion Commander of a Regency Guard; his father was Zhao Liang 亮, Vice Director in the Ministry of Rites; his father's former wife was Lady Qian 錢氏, and his mother is Lady Meng 孟氏. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Zhao Wan 琬, Left Admonisher in the Supervisorate of Household Administration in charge of the affairs of Director of Studies in the Directorate of Education, as well as Zhao Hong 洪, Zhao Chen 辰, Zhao Le 樂, Zhao Wo 沃, Zhao Xun 塤, and Zhao Chi 篪. He is married to Lady Zhu 朱氏. He placed thirteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Kui 張奎 (registered in a civilian household of Shishou County 石首縣, Jingzhou Prefecture 荊州府, Huguang 湖廣; Added Student of the County School; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Hanwen 漢文; first in seniority; aged twenty-four, born on the twelfth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Zhiling 志齡; his grandfather is Zhang Lunti 論倜, Directorate Student; his father is Zhang Gongxu 功敘, Commissioner-in-chief; his mother is Lady Zhao 趙氏. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brother is Zhang Yi 翼. He is married to Lady Zhu 朱氏. He placed one hundred thirty-sixth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and two hundred thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Tan 于坦: Registered in a commoner household of Shizhou, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Shangping; fourth in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-one, born on the twenty-eighth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Yu Tingzhong; his grandfather was Yu Shixian; his father is Yu Yuan (District Magistrate); his mother was née Zhang, and his stepmothers are née Li and née Gao. His grandparents and parents are living. His elder brothers are Yu Tai [annotated: 俒 [?]], Yu Zeng, Yu Yin, and Yu Ba; his younger brother is Yu Tan [?]. He married née Zhang. He placed thirty-seventh in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and three hundred and ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Ji 王稽: Registered in an official household of Jinxi County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; an Added Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yunzhe; seventh in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-six, born on the sixth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Wang Ning; his grandfather was Wang Zhonghe; his father was Wang Zhong (Instructor); his mother was née Gao, and his stepmother is née Cheng. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Wang He, Wang Ji, and Wang Hong; his younger brothers are Wang Mu and Wang Chong. He married née Huang. He placed ninety-seventh in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and three hundred and fifteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Mao Jie 毛傑: Registered in a commoner household of Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Confucian Scholar specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Yunqi; fifth in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-one, born on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Mao Shutai; his grandfather is Mao Bai; his father is Mao Yong; his uncle is Mao Ji (a metropolitan graduate of the same examination class); his mother is née Huang. His grandparents and parents are living. His elder brother is Mao Yu (Tribute Student); his younger brothers are Mao Zuo, Mao Zhen, Mao Xuan, Mao Jin, Mao Cai, and Mao Peng. He married née Zhou. He placed fifty-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Lin 李麟: Registered in a commoner household of Juye County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wenrui; second in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-nine, born on the fourth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Li Zhongmei; his grandfather was Li Junmei; his father is Li Qi (Commissioner-in-chief); his mother was née Gao, and his father's concubine is née Pang. His father is living. His elder brother is Li Qi; his younger brother is Li Hong. He married née Qu. He placed thirty-ninth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred and fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

田濟〔貫陝西鳳翔府麟遊縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字汝霖，行一，年三十三，五月初六日生〕。曾祖彥卿〔訓導〕；祖榮；父源〔典儀正〕；母趙氏，繼母楊氏。慈侍下，弟澤，娶梁氏。陝西鄉試第十四名，會試第三十九名。
translation_en:
Wang Sheng 王昇 (registered under civilian status in Miyun County, Shuntian Prefecture; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Qidong; first in his generation; age thirty-four, born on the twenty-sixth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Wang Mian, his grandfather was Wang Gang, his father is Wang Jun, and his mother is Lady Zhang. Both of his parents are living; his elder brothers are Wang Xin and Wang Xing, his younger brothers are Wang Lin and Wang Feng, and he married Lady Li. He ranked eighty-sixth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and three hundred and third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hong Mian 洪冕 (registered under artisan status in Chengdu County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Tingzhang; first in his generation; age twenty-seven, born on the sixteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Hong Zixian, his grandfather was Hong De'an, his father was Hong Ming, and his mother is Lady Chen. His mother is living; his elder brother is Hong Yongtai, his younger brother is Hong Yongchang, and he married Lady Yang. He ranked third in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred and eighty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Tai 曹泰 (registered under military status in Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; Added Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Yi'an; fourth in his generation; age twenty-one, born on the eighteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Cao Fuyi, his grandfather was Cao Chuyang, his father is Cao Chen, and his mother is Lady Deng. Both of his parents are living; his elder brothers are Cao Fu, Cao Yi, and Cao Ding, his younger brothers are Cao Jie and Cao Zhen, and he married Lady Jin. He ranked one hundred and forty-sixth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tian Ji 田濟 (registered under civilian status in Linyou County, Fengxiang Prefecture, Shaanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Rulin; first in his generation; age thirty-three, born on the sixth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Tian Yanqing (Assistant Instructor), his grandfather was Tian Rong, his father was Tian Yuan (Director of Ceremonies), his mother was Lady Zhao, and his stepmother is Lady Yang. His stepmother is living; his younger brother is Tian Ze, and he married Lady Liang. He ranked fourteenth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Liu Jie 劉傑 (registered in a military household in Gaoling County 高陵縣, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi 陝西; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Shiying 世英; second in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the second day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Yunde 劉允德, his grandfather was Liu Zhen 劉振, his father is Liu Ping 劉平, and his mother is née Zheng 鄭氏. Both of his parents are living; his younger brothers are Liu Juan 劉儶, Liu Kan 劉侃, and Liu Ru 劉儒; he married née Wei 魏氏, and remarried née Wang 王氏. He placed 30th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 157th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Guan 徐觀 (registered in a military household in Xiangshan County 香山縣, Guangzhou Prefecture 廣州府, Guangdong 廣東; an Added County Student specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Ziming 子明; second in his generation; age twenty-five, born on the eleventh day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Xu Yinglin 徐應麟, his grandfather was Xu Bogao 徐伯高, his father is Xu Zhizhong 徐致中, and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. Both of his parents are living; his younger brothers are Xu Lan 徐覽 and Xu Jue 徐覺; he married née Zhou 周氏. He placed 85th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 90th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bi Heng 畢亨 (registered in a military household of the Henan Guard 河南衛, a native of Shan County 單縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 兖州府, Shandong 山東; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Wenheng 文亨; sixth in his generation; age thirty-five, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Bi Junyong 畢均用, his grandfather was Bi Shan 畢山 (Battalion Commander under the Yuan), his father was Bi Rong 畢榮, his father's former wives were née Yang 楊氏 and née Wu 武氏, and his mother was née Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are deceased; his elder brothers are Bi Wang 畢旺, Bi Xing 畢興, Bi Tong 畢通, Bi Da 畢達, and Bi Tai 畢泰; he married née Wang 汪氏. He placed 2nd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 260th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Xiang 趙相 (registered in a civilian household in Shan County 單縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 兖州府, Shandong 山東; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Wenqing 文卿; third in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-first day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Zhao Mengxian 趙孟賢 (Route Commander under the Yuan), his grandfather was Zhao Boliang 趙伯諒, his father was Zhao Lun 趙倫 (Investigating Censor), and his mother is née Chen 陳氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased; his elder brothers are Zhao Deng 趙登 and Zhao Yin 趙殷; he married née Chen 塵氏. He placed 58th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 324th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Dai Qi 戴琪 (registered in a military household in Mianchi County, Henan Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Tingbi; fifth in his generation; age thirty-two, born on the nineteenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Congshan; his grandfather was Hui; his father was Zhen (District Magistrate); his mother was née Guo, and his stepmother was née Yang. With his mother living, he has elder brothers Li, Lin, Lin, Yan, and Bing, and he married née Yuan and remarried née Fan. He ranked ninety-fourth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred and eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yu 李裕 (registered in a military household in Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; Added Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Zide; first in his generation; age thirty-one, born on the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Kejing; his grandfather was Zhongzhi; his father was Duanming; his mother was née Zhou, and his stepmother was née Xiong. With both parents living, he has an elder brother Yuchun, and younger brothers Rong, Cai, Xu [?], Ge, and Xi, and he married née Luo. He ranked twenty-ninth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and ninety-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Jiqing 劉季清 (registered in a military household in Nanchang County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Shilian; sixth in his generation; age forty-eight, born on the thirtieth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Mengjin; his grandfather was Zhongli; his father was Shuda; his father's former wife was née Tao, and his mother was née Huang. With his mother living, he has elder brothers Jiluo [?], Jisi, and Jifan, and a younger brother Jijing, and he married née Wu and remarried née Xu. He ranked twelfth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and ninety-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Shen 徐紳 (registered in a civilian household in Qi County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; County School Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Gongyi; second in his generation; age thirty-four, born on the nineteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Wei; his grandfather was Jingsheng (Right Administration Commissioner of the Guangdong Provincial Administration Commission); his father was Zheng (Vice Commissioner); his mother was née Li, and his stepmother was née Wang. With both parents living, he has elder brothers Yan, Zeng, and Lun, and a younger brother Shou, and he married née Li. He ranked ninth in the Henan Provincial Examination and three hundred and twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Si 李嗣 [registered in a civilian household of Nanhai County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Kecheng, third in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the fourth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Yanfang, his grandfather was Dingyuan, his father was Pu, and his mother is née Xiao. His mother is living. His elder brothers are He and Zai; his younger brothers are Ning, Kang, Shan, and Chang. He married née Luo. He placed sixteenth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Rui 鄭瑞 [registered in a wealthy household (fuhu) of Daxing County, Shuntian Prefecture, originally from Xi'an County, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Mengxiang, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the sixth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Deqing, his grandfather was Ai [Righteous Commoner (yimin)], his father is Hu, his mother was née Fang, and his stepmother is née Lou. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Ban, Xi, Yu, Pin, Ke, Gui, Zhang, Xiang, Xu, and Yan. He married née Xu. He placed one hundred and fifty-ninth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pei Zhong 裴衷 [registered in a civilian household of Shikang County, Lianzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Bingyi, eighth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the fourteenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Shi [Commissioner-in-chief (dashi)], his grandfather was Gang, his father is Kangyao, and his mother is née Hong. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Fu, Yu, and Ying; his younger brother is You. He married née Li. He placed tenth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and sixty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yu 李璵 [registered in a civilian household of Xiangfu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Tingrui, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the nineteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Sugong [Office Manager in the Bureau of Military Affairs (shumi yuan dushi) under the Yuan dynasty], his grandfather was Zhao, his father is Yongwen [Administrative Assistant (panguan)], and his mother is née Teng. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Xuan, and his younger brother is Qi. He married née Zheng, and remarried née Qi. He placed twenty-second in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred and forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xia Zhong 夏忠: Registered under a military household in the Dezhou Guard in the Directly Attached region (Zhili), originally from Dangtu County. He is a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name is Kecheng, he is the first in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-three years old, born on the first day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Yongyi, his grandfather was Jincai, his father was Xingsi, and his mother is née Shi. His mother is living and his father is deceased. He has an elder brother, Wende, and younger brothers, Shu and Wude. He is married to née Ren. He ranked fifty-seventh in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Lu 王嚧: Registered under a civilian household in Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian. He is an Added Student at the Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His courtesy name is Tingqi, he is third in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-one years old, born on the twenty-ninth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Dingxin, his grandfather was Xiong, his father is Bojian, and his mother is née Shao. Both of his parents are living. He has an elder brother, Kang, and younger brothers, Jin, Chun, and Lian. He married née Zheng, and took née Lan as his second wife. He ranked eighteenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Shu 郭舒: Registered under a civilian household in Longxi County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian. He is a Prefectural School Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His courtesy name is Duanzhuang, he is second in seniority among his brothers, and he is twenty years old, born on the twelfth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Shihui; his grandfather was Bangwen, who served as a Prefectural Director of Studies; his father was Shuoping, and his mother is née Huang. His mother is living and his father is deceased. He has an elder brother, Duancheng. He is married to née Lin. He ranked fifty-second in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Xuan 楊宣: Registered under a civilian household in Le'an County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi. He is a County School Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name is Zise, he is second in seniority among his brothers, and he is thirty-nine years old, born on the twenty-third day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Yuheng, his grandfather was Bohong, his father was Suihong, his legal mother was née Huang, and his birth mother was née Zhang. Both of his parents are deceased. He has an elder brother, Zijia, and younger brothers, Zigeng, Ziyun, and Ziji. He is married to née Nie. He ranked fifty-third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and eighty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Mengsheng 陳孟晟 [registered in a medical household in Tongling County, Chizhou Prefecture, Zhili; a County School Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shanghui; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the fifth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Mijian; his grandfather was Chen Siliang [Medical Prefectural Instructor]; his father was Chen Yue; his mother was née He, and his stepmothers were née Li and née Sun. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Chen Mengchang, and his younger brothers are Chen Mengbing and Chen Mengxian [Assistant Instructor]. He is married to née Yao. He placed 142nd in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 70th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Chen 楊琛 [registered in a military household in Wuxi County, Changzhou Prefecture, Zhili; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shuxian; twelfth in seniority among his brothers and cousins; aged twenty-six, born on the thirtieth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Guang; his grandfather was Yang Yuanzhen; his paternal uncles were Yang Zongyuan [Secretary in the Ministry of Personnel] and Yang Zonghao [Instructor]; his father was Yang Zonghai; his mother is née Zhu. His mother is living. His elder brothers (and cousins) are Yang Gui, Yang Min, Yang Xuan [Administration Vice Commissioner of the Shanxi Provincial Administration Commission], Yang Xun, Yang Yan, Yang Fan, and Yang Li, and his younger brother is Yang Zhen. He is married to née Yu. He placed 63rd in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 298th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shi Lan 史蘭 [registered in a commoner household in Licheng County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; a Prefectural School Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Tingfang; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the sixth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Shi Caixing; his grandfather was Shi Weishan; his father was Shi Rong; his mother is née Li. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Shi Fang and Shi Zao. He is married to née Fu. He placed 1st in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 348th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Mao Biao 茂彪 [registered in a military household of the Qingyang Guard, Shaanxi, originally from Jiangdu County, Zhili; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zongyi; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the sixteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Mao Kecheng; his grandfather was Mao Sheng; his father was Mao Wen; his mother is née Sha. His mother is living. His elder brother is Mao Lin, and his younger brothers are Mao Hong and Mao Yuan. He is married to née Du. He placed 8th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 38th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhang Gang 張綱: Registered in a military household in Changqing County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong, he is a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His style name is Dazhen, he is the third son in his family line, and he was born on the twenty-third day of the fourth month, aged thirty-three [?; text reads "thirteen years"]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Boliang; his grandfather was Zhang Zhongwen (posthumously honoured as Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Justice); his father was Zhang Jin (Department Magistrate); and his mother is née Yang (invested as Child Nurturess [?]). His mother is living. His elder brother is Zhang Jing, and he is married to née Li. He placed ninth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred and thirty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Xi 張僖: Registered in a civilian household in Lingbi County, Fengyang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), he is an Added Student in the county school specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji). His style name is Shile, he is the fourth son in his family line, and he was born on the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month, aged twenty-nine. His great-grandfather was Zhang Gongxun; his grandfather was Zhang Gan, his grand-uncle was Zhang Shi; his father's younger brother [or father, garbled?] was Zhang Ziyun (Military Graduate); and his mother is née Ren. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Zhang Zhu, Zhang Jie, and Zhang Bao; his younger brother is Zhang Fu; and he is married to née Sheng. He placed eighteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural (Provincial) Examination and two hundred and twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Long Lin 龍霖: Registered in a civilian household in Xinfeng County, Ganzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi, he is an Added Student in the county school specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His style name is Yongmo, he is the second son in his family line, and he is thirty-three years old, born on the twelfth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather is Long Junshao; his grandfather is Long Yanchen; his father is Long Mengduo; and his mother is née Li. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Long Yongjin; his paternal elder male cousin is Long Xiao; his younger brothers are Long Yongjing and Long Yongfu; and he is married to née Wang. He placed nineteenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Qi 武齊: Registered in a civilian household in Le'an County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi, he is an Added Student in the county school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His style name is Tangqing, he is the second son in his family line, and he is [illegible] years old, born on [illegible]. His great-grandfather was Wu Boshun; his grandfather was Wu Yongzhang; his father is Wu [illegible]; and his mother is née [illegible]. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wu Yu and Wu Li [or Wu Yuli]; his younger brother is Wu [illegible]; and he is married to née [illegible]. He placed [illegible] in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and [illegible] in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Liu Xuan 劉瑄 (registered in a military household in Shen Department 深州, Zhending Prefecture 真定府, Direct-attached Region [Zhili 直隸]; National University Student [guozi sheng]; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Zongqi 宗器; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one sui, born on the sixteenth day of the eleventh month): his great-grandfather was Liu Qilao 七老, his grandfather was Liu Fude 福德, his father was Liu Yu 愉, and his mother was née Zhou 周氏. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Liu Tan 潭 and Liu An 安, and his younger brother is Liu Kuan 寬. He married née Ge 葛氏. He placed 80th in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and 265th in the Metropolitan Examination.
Wang Lin 王璘 (registered in a military household of the Nanjing Sacrificial Animal Office 南京犧牲所, a native of Luling County 廬陵縣, Jiangxi 江西; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Tingxiu 廷秀; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five sui, born on the fifth day of the intercalary twelfth month): his great-grandfather was Wang Wenshan 文善, his grandfather was Wang Siyu 思與, his father is Wang Binghui 秉惠, and his mother is née Zhang 張氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Wang Tingqi 廷器. He married née Qian 錢氏, and remarried née Xu 許氏. He placed 176th in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and 67th in the Metropolitan Examination.
Wu Qi 吳玘 (registered in a civilian household in Huating County 華亭縣, Songjiang Prefecture 松江府, Direct-attached Region [Zhili]; County Student [xian xuesheng]; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Zhongyu 仲玉; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one sui, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eighth month): his great-grandfather was Wu Zhongwen 仲文, his grandfather was Wu Peng 捧 (District Magistrate [zhixian]), his father is Wu Fu 甫, and his mother was née Shou 壽氏. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brother is Wu Cong 琮. He married née Li 李氏. He placed 45th in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and 210th in the Metropolitan Examination.
Liu Qing 劉清 (registered in a civilian household in Luoyang County 洛陽縣, Henan Prefecture 河南府, Henan 河南; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Yuanjie 源潔; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two sui, born on the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth month): his great-grandfather was Liu Yancheng 彥誠, his grandfather was Liu Zhi 志, his father was Liu Jun 俊, his father's former wife was née Song 宋氏, and his mother is née Li 李氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Liu Tong 通 and Liu Ying 瑛. He married née Wang 王氏. He placed 5th in the Henan 河南 Provincial Examination and 214th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Liu Zi 劉孜 [registered under military household status in Longxi County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shikan; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty, born on the fourth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Tinggao, his grandfather was Hui, his father is Menglin, and his mother is née Zhang. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Rong, and he is married to née Wang. He placed third in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 293rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ran Zhe 冉哲 [registered under civilian household status in Neijiang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shangyi; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged forty-three, born on the nineteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhongwen, his grandfather was Xiuchuan, his father was Zhiming, and his mother was née Han. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yu [Tribute Student (gongshi)], Sheng, and Yong, and he is married to née Yin. He placed second in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 285th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Geng 吳庚 [registered under civilian household status in Luoyang County, Henan Prefecture, Henan; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zhongming; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the fourth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Cheng, his grandfather was Hai, his father was Zheng [Assistant Prefect], his father's former wife was née Luo, and his mother was née Guo. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Xu, Guang, and Yong, and he is married to née Li. He placed seventeenth in the Henan Provincial Examination and 182nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Ji 劉岌 [registered under military household status in Fuzhou Department, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; Department Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Lingyun; third in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the fourth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Yinglong, his grandfather was Yide [County Magistrate], his father was Yi, his father's former wife was née Kan, and his mother is née Zhang. His mother is living. His elder paternal cousin is Yan [Medical Practitioner in the Imperial Academy of Medicine], his elder brother is Xian, and he is married to née Yang. He placed forty-ninth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 139th in the Metropolitan Examination.

伍驥〔貫江西吉安府安福縣民籍，縣學生，治《春秋》，字體馴，行二，年二十九，二月十一日生〕。曾祖洪〔辛亥進士〕，祖述經，父冕〔知縣〕，母彭氏，繼母黃氏。嚴侍下。兄體祥，弟體躍、體和、體極。娶劉氏，繼娶彭氏，繼娶劉氏。江西鄉試第一百三十八名，會試第六十八名。

魏瀚〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣官籍，縣學增廣生，治《春秋》，字宗淵，行二，年二十九，七月六日生〕。曾祖子祥，祖賓，父瑤〔縣丞〕，母王氏。具慶下。兄漠，弟瀧、溥、泂。娶陳氏。浙江鄉試第五十五名，會試第二百四名。
translation_en:
Luo Ming 羅明 (registered in a civilian household of Chongren County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; a District Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Yuanliang; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-third day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Mengwei; his grandfather was Haowen; his father is Junshi; his mother is née Zhang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is De, and his younger brothers are Li and Zheng. He married née Wu. He placed twenty-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tian Jingyang 田景暘 (registered in a civilian household of Gaoyang County, Baoding Prefecture, Zhili; an Added Student of the county school; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Shizhong; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-seventh day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Shizhong; his grandfather is Jia; his father is Fu (Prefectural Director of Schools); his mother is née Shao. Both of his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Jingzhao, Jingkui, Jingqin, Jingxi, Jinghui, and Jingzhang. He married née Liu. He placed seventh in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and two hundred twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Ji 伍驥 (registered in a civilian household of Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a District Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Tixun; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the eleventh day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Hong (a metropolitan graduate [jinshi] of the xinhai year [1371]); his grandfather was Shujing; his father is Mian (District Magistrate); his mother was née Peng, and his stepmother is née Huang. His father is living. His elder brother is Tixiang, and his younger brothers are Tiyue, Tihe, and Tiji. He married née Liu, then married née Peng, and then married née Liu. He placed one hundred thirty-eighth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wei Han 魏瀚 (registered in an official household of Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; an Added Student of the county school; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Zongyuan; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the sixth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Zixiang; his grandfather was Bin; his father is Yao (Vice Magistrate); his mother is née Wang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Mo, and his younger brothers are Long, Pu, and Jiong. He married née Chen. He placed fifty-fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

程泰〔貫直隸徽州府祁門縣軍籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字用元，行一，年三十，正月初一日生〕。曾祖汝楫；祖景華；父顯〔左長史〕；母齊氏。重慶下。弟貫、通、復、宣。娶汪氏，繼娶胡氏。應天府鄉試第二十一名，會試第一百三十二名。

杜庠〔貫直隸蘇州府長洲縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《書經》，字公序，行一，年二十八，七月初四日生〕。曾祖均美；祖士彝；父文昌；母鄒氏。嚴侍下。弟廉。娶錢氏。應天府鄉試第一百一名，會試第二百十七名。

葉頥〔貫廣東都司惠州衛中千戶所軍餘，惠州府學生，治《書經》，字養正，行一，年二十九，九月二十六日生〕。曾祖石安；祖蘭馨；父生；母陳氏。具慶下。弟順。娶彭氏。廣東鄉試第二十二名，會試第二百四十九名。

金紳〔貫應天府上元縣官籍，儒士，治《書經》，字縉卿，行四，年二十一，五月初五日生〕。曾祖仲銘；祖原亮；父潤〔知府〕；母潘氏。重慶下。兄綬夫、黼臣。娶徐氏。應天府鄉試第一百九名，會試第三百三十二名。
translation_en:
Cheng Tai 程泰, registered under a military household in Qimen County 祁門縣, Huizhou Prefecture 徽州府, in the Directly Attached region (Zhili 直隸), was a Student of the National University (Guozisheng 國子生) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu). His courtesy name was Yongyuan 用元; he was the first in seniority among his brothers, and was thirty years old, born on the first day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Cheng Ruji 汝楫; his grandfather was Cheng Jinghua 景華; his father was Cheng Xian 顯, a Left Administrator of a Princely Establishment (Zuo zhangshi 左長史); and his mother was née Qi 齊. His grandparents and parents were still living (chongqing xia 重慶下). His younger brothers were Guan 貫, Tong 通, Fu 復, and Xuan 宣; he married née Wang 汪, and after her death married née Hu 胡. He ranked 21st in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 132nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Du Xiang 杜庠, registered under a commoner household in Changzhou County 長洲縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, in the Directly Attached region (Zhili), was an Added Student of the County School (xianxue zengguangsheng 縣學增廣生) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His courtesy name was Gongxu 公序; he was the first in seniority among his brothers, and was twenty-eight years old, born on the fourth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Du Junmei 均美; his grandfather was Du Shiyi 士彝; his father was Du Wenchang 文昌; and his mother was née Zou 鄒. His father was living and his mother deceased (yanshi xia 嚴侍下). His younger brother was Lian 廉; he married née Qian 錢. He ranked 101st in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 217th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ye Yi 葉頥, registered as a supernumerary soldier (junyu 軍餘) of the Central Chiliarchy (Zhong qianhusuo 中千戶所) of Huizhou Guard 惠州衛 under the Guangdong Regional Military Commission (Guangdong dusi 廣東都司), was a Student of the Huizhou Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His courtesy name was Yangzheng 養正; he was the first in seniority among his brothers, and was twenty-nine years old, born on the twenty-sixth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Ye Shi'an 石安; his grandfather was Ye Lanxin 蘭馨; his father was Ye Sheng 生; and his mother was née Chen 陳. Both of his parents were living (juqing xia 具慶下). His younger brother was Shun 順; he married née Peng 彭. He ranked 22nd in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 249th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jin Shen 金紳, registered under an official household in Shangyuan County 上元縣, Yingtian Prefecture 應天府, was a Confucian Scholar (rushi 儒士) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His courtesy name was Jinqing 縉卿; he was the fourth in seniority among his brothers, and was twenty-one years old, born on the fifth day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Jin Zhongming 仲銘; his grandfather was Jin Yuanliang 原亮; his father was Jin Run 潤, a Prefect (Zhifu 知府); and his mother was née Pan 潘. His grandparents and parents were still living (chongqing xia). His elder brothers were Shoufu 綬夫 and Fuchen 黼臣; he married née Xu 徐. He ranked 109th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 332nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Li Yue 李岳 (registered in a civilian household of Changyuan County, Daming Prefecture, in the Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Yangzhan 仰瞻; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-second day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Tingbi 廷璧 (Supervisor of the Medical School under the Yuan); his grandfathers were Yijing 以敬 and Hengyi 恒彛 [?]; his father is Shide 士德 (Prefectural Physician [zhengke]); and his mother is née Zhang 張. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Dai 岱 and Chong 崇, and his younger brothers are Wei 巍 and Kun 崑. He married a woman née Bu 步. He placed twelfth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and three hundred and twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng An 鄭安 (registered in a civilian household of Haiyang County, Chaozhou Prefecture, Guangdong; a Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Kangmin 康民; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the tenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Lin 遴; his grandfather was Ren 仁; his father was Qian 虔; and his mother is née Li 李. His mother is living; his younger brother is Yu 寓. He married a woman née Wu 吳. He placed first in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and twenty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Jie 吳節 (registered in a civilian household of Meizhou Subprefecture, Sichuan; a Subprefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Xingjian 行儉; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the eighteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Xingwen 興文; his grandfather was Zezhao 則昭; his father was Wenzheng 文政 (posthumously honoured as Investigating Censor); and his mother was née Liu 劉 (posthumously honoured as Child Nurturer [ruren]). Both parents are deceased; his elder brothers are Zhong 中 (Investigating Censor) and Sheng 昇, and his younger brother is Shi 式. He married a woman née Zhou 周. He placed second in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Zhen 黃甄 (registered in a civilian household of Shouguang County, Qingzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Qizhi 器之; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the eighth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Shirong 世榮; his grandfather was Bingwen 秉文; his father is Gang 剛; and his mother is née Li 李. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are [?] [CN], Zhui 甀, Yan 甗, and Han 甝. He married a woman née Zhou 周. He placed twenty-sixth in the [Shandong Provincial Examination?] [□□] and thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

蕭惟昌
貫錦衣衛軍籍廣東吳川縣人　軍
治易經字有慶行一年三十七六月初九日生
曾祖敬甫　祖弘道　父希勝　母莊氏　繼母祠氏
慈侍下　弟信　惠　儉　讓　娶凌氏
順天府鄉試第二百三十四名　會試第二百二十六名
punctuated:
李述〔貫江西南昌府豐城縣民籍，儒士，治《詩經》，字繼之，行六，年二十七，六月十二日生〕。曾祖克恭，伯祖玉璋〔主簿〕，祖玉琪，父尚慶，母皮氏。具慶下，兄化之、敬之、立之、紹之，弟順之、通之、顯之。娶熊氏。江西鄉試第一百十名，會試第二百四十五名。

張賛〔貫四川潼川州遂寧縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《春秋》，字邦翊，行四，年三十，二月十日生〕。曾祖明佐，祖泰林，父永成，母余氏。永感下，兄澍、澤、濟。娶王氏。四川鄉試第十四名，會試第二百五十名。

毛吉〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字宗吉，行七，年三十三，六月初十日生〕。曾祖實，祖伯珹，父仕璵，母鄔氏。慈侍下，兄洪，弟淪、灴。娶熊氏。浙江鄉試第五十三名，會試第二百三十五名。

蕭惟昌〔貫錦衣衛軍籍，廣東吳川縣人，軍，治《易經》，字有慶，行一，年三十七，六月初九日生〕。曾祖敬甫，祖弘道，父希勝，母莊氏，繼母柯氏。慈侍下，弟信、惠、儉、讓。娶凌氏。順天府鄉試第二百三十四名，會試第二百二十八名。
translation_en:
Li Shu 李述 [registered under civilian status in Fengcheng County 豐城縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西; a Confucian scholar (rushi) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jizhi 繼之; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twelfth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Kegong 克恭; his grand-uncle was Li Yuzhang 玉璋 [Assistant Magistrate]; his grandfather was Li Yuqi 玉琪; his father is Li Shangqing 尚慶; and his mother is née Pi 皮氏. Both of his parents are living; his elder brothers are Li Huazhi 化之, Li Jingzhi 敬之, Li Lizhi 立之, and Li Shaozhi 紹之; his younger brothers are Li Shunzhi 順之, Li Tongzhi 通之, and Li Xianzhi 顯之; and he is married to née Xiong 熊氏. He ranked 110th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 245th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Zan 張賛 [registered under civilian status in Suining County 遂寧縣, Tongchuan Subprefecture 潼川州, Sichuan 四川; an added student (zengguang sheng) of the county school specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Bangyi 邦翊; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the tenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Mingzuo 明佐, his grandfather was Zhang Tailin 泰林, his father was Zhang Yongcheng 永成, and his mother was née Yu 余氏. Both of his parents are deceased; his elder brothers are Zhang Shu 澍, Zhang Ze 澤, and Zhang Ji 濟; and he is married to née Wang 王氏. He ranked 14th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 250th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Mao Ji 毛吉 [registered under civilian status in Yuyao County 餘姚縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang 浙江; a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zongji 宗吉; seventh in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the tenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Mao Shi 實, his grandfather was Mao Bocheng 伯珹, his father was Mao Shiyu 仕璵, and his mother is née Wu 鄔氏. His father is deceased and his mother is living; his elder brother is Mao Hong 洪; his younger brothers are Mao Lun 淪 and Mao Hong 灴; and he is married to née Xiong 熊氏. He ranked 53rd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 235th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Weichang 蕭惟昌 [registered under military status in the Embroidered-uniform Guard (Jinyi Wei), a native of Wuchuan County 吳川縣, Guangdong 廣東; a soldier specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Youqing 有慶; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the ninth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Xiao Jingfu 敬甫, his grandfather was Xiao Hongdao 弘道, his father was Xiao Xisheng 希勝, his mother was née Zhuang 莊氏, and his stepmother is née Ke 柯氏. His father is deceased and his stepmother is living; his younger brothers are Xiao Xin 信, Xiao Hui 惠, Xiao Jian 儉, and Xiao Rang 讓; and he is married to née Ling 凌氏. He ranked 234th in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and 228th in the Metropolitan Examination.

順天府鄉試第六十九名　會試第一百五十名
punctuated:
段堅〔貫陝西肅府儀衛司軍籍，山西陽曲縣人，蘭縣學軍生，治《易經》，字可久，行二，年三十六，六月二十一日生〕。曾祖本；祖鳴鶴；父敏，前母田氏，母張氏，繼母周氏。具慶下，兄春，弟楷、枋。娶李氏，繼娶咬氏。陝西鄉試第二十八名，會試第六名。

宋澄〔貫福建興化府莆田縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《書經》，字惟清，行二，年二十三，五月初十日生〕。曾祖彥明；祖回；父崇圭，母朱氏。具慶下，兄惟司。娶黃氏。福建鄉試第四十九名，會試第一百二十六名。

呂洪〔貫浙江温州府平陽縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字大正，行四，年三十八，十一月二十日生〕。曾祖復中；祖敏德；父再謙，母楊氏。慈侍下，兄浩、潭、洄。娶徐氏。浙江鄉試第三名，會試第二百七十四名。

楊懋〔貫順天府宛平縣匠籍，浙江錢塘縣人，國子生，治《春秋》，字克勤，行四，年三十，閏七月二十日生〕。曾祖純素；祖敬先；父存忠，母章氏。慈侍下，兄清，弟正。娶何氏。順天府鄉試第六十九名，會試第一百五十名。
translation_en:
Duan Jian 段堅: Registered under a military household in the Ceremonial Guard of the Princely Establishment of Su in Shaanxi, originally from Yangqu County, Shanxi; a military student at the Lan County School specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Kejiu, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-first day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Duan Ben; his grandfather was Duan Minghe; his father is Duan Min, his father's former wife was Lady Tian, his mother was Lady Zhang, and his stepmother is Lady Zhou. Both parents are living (father and stepmother); he has an elder brother, Duan Chun, and younger brothers, Duan Kai and Duan Fang. He married Lady Li, and subsequently married Lady Yao. He placed twenty-eighth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Song Cheng 宋澄: Registered under a commoner household in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; anAdded Student (zengguang sheng) at the county school specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Weiqing, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-three, born on the tenth day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Song Yanming; his grandfather was Song Hui; his father is Song Chonggui, and his mother is Lady Zhu. Both parents are living; he has an elder brother, Song Weisi. He married Lady Huang. He placed forty-ninth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lü Hong 呂洪: Registered under a commoner household in Pingyang County, Wenzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Dazheng, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-eight, born on the twentieth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Lü Fuzhong; his grandfather was Lü Minde; his father was Lü Zaiqian, and his mother is Lady Yang. His mother is living; he has elder brothers, Lü Hao, Lü Tan, and Lü Hui. He married Lady Xu. He placed third in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Mao 楊懋: Registered under an artisan household in Wanping County, Shuntian Prefecture, originally from Qiantang County, Zhejiang; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Keqin, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the twentieth day of the intercalary seventh month. His great-grandfather was Yang Chunsu; his grandfather was Yang Jingxian; his father was Yang Cunzhong, and his mother is Lady Zhang. His mother is living; he has an elder brother, Yang Qing, and a younger brother, Yang Zheng. He married Lady He. He placed sixty-ninth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

樊英〔貫陝西西安府臨潼縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字世傑，行一，年二十九，七月二十六日生〕。曾祖智名；祖恭禮；父大用；母王氏，繼母薛氏。具慶下。弟俊。娶劉氏，繼娶羅氏。順天府鄉試第二十一名，會試第一百三十名。

白侃〔貫山西太原府平定州軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字廷直，行三，年三十三，八月初一日生〕。曾祖德興；祖勳〔楚府典儀〕；父琦；母石氏。具慶下。兄份、俌，弟儀、仔。娶趙氏。山西鄉試第九名，會試第十六名。

汪振〔貫江西廣信府貴溪縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字季和，行四，年三十二，二月二十九日生〕。曾祖孟進；祖□文〔□□史〕；父彥銘；母熊氏。嚴侍下。弟□、規、□、□。娶孫氏。應天府鄉試第□□□名，會試第□□四名。

謝廉〔貫錦衣衛官籍，直隸長洲縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字允清，行二，年三十三，七月初一日生〕。曾祖宗明；祖得仁〔贈錦衣衛管軍所鎮撫〕；父通〔錦衣衛鎮撫司所鎮撫〕；母翁氏〔贈安人〕。具慶下。兄悳，弟恭、儉、讓、儒、佑、亨、序。娶王氏。順天府鄉試第七十三名，會試第二百一名。
translation_en:
Fan Ying 樊英 [registered in a civilian household of Lintong County 臨潼縣, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi 陝西; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Shijie 世傑; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-sixth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Fan Zhiming 智名; his grandfather was Fan Gongli 恭禮; his father was Fan Dayong 大用; his mother was Lady Wang 王氏, and his stepmother was Lady Xue 薛氏. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brother is Fan Jun 俊. He married Lady Liu 劉氏, and remarried Lady Luo 羅氏. He placed twenty-first in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and 130th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Shi Defu; his grandfather was Shi Shouzhi; his father is Shi Bangyan [Instructor]; and his mother was née Song. His father is living. His elder brothers are Shi Rong and Shi Hui. He is married to née Shen. He ranked 100th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 31st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Shugu 張述古 [registered in a military household of Yixing County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Added Student of the county school; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Xinzhi; sixth in seniority among brothers; age twenty-seven, born on the fifteenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Boying; his grandfather is Zhang Yongde; his father is Zhang Yuankai; and his mother is née Chu. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Fangu, Zhang Minggu, and Zhang Fenggu, and his younger brothers are Zhang Qiugu, Zhang Yungu, Zhang Xigu, and Zhang Xigu 習古. He is married to née Lu. Mao Lun 毛倫 [registered in a military household of Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; Directorate Student; specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Tianxu; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-eight, born on the twenty-first day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Mao Zejing; his grandfather was Mao Shaowu; his father is Mao Zhongying, and his paternal uncle is Mao Zhongling [Instructor]; and his mother is née Li. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Mao Jin, Mao Jing, Mao Chun, Mao Shou, and Mao Quan. He is married to née Zhang. He ranked 33rd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 224th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Ke 孫珂 [registered in a military household of Fushan County, Dengzhou Prefecture, Shandong; Added Student of the county school; specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Tingzhen; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fourth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Sun Zhixiao; his grandfather was Sun Yanbin [posthumously honored as Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue]; his father is Sun Yu [Prefect]; and his mother is née Fang [invested as Master Mistress]. He ranked 8th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 43rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Yang Jingli 敬禮 (posthumously granted the prestige title General of Martial Virtue); his grandfather was Yang Bin 斌; his father is Yang Shineng 仕能; and his mother is née Su 蘇氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Yang Yi 宜 and Yang Ding 定; he is married to a woman née Wang 王氏. He placed 40th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 266th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gao Liang 高亮 (registered in a military household of the Left Embroidered-Uniform Guard of Martial Steeds [Wuxiang Left Guard], native of Ganquan County, Yan'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Shangming 尚明; first in seniority; aged thirty-five, born on the seventh day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Gao Chongli 崇禮; his grandfather was Gao Shizhong 仕中; his father is Gao Dayong 大用; and his mother is née Hou 侯氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Gao Ning 寧, and his younger brother is Gao Jin 錦; he is married to a woman née Liu 劉氏. He placed 24th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 179th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Ang 李昂 (registered in a civilian household of Renhe County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; Added Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Wenju 文舉; third in seniority; aged twenty-one, born on the eleventh day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Li Shirong 士榮; his grandfather was Li Wenzhong 紋中; his father was Li Zhen 禎; his father's first wife was née Qiao 喬氏; and his mother is née Wu 吳氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Li Mian 冕 and Li Sheng 晟; he is betrothed to a woman née Sheng 盛氏. He placed 50th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 190th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Chong 劉充 (registered in a civilian household of Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Gongkuo 恭擴; third in seniority; aged forty, born on the fourteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Jucun 菊存; his grandfather was Liu Miyuan 彌遠; his father was Liu Tixin 體信; and his mother is née Peng 彭氏. His mother is living. His younger brother is Liu Gongzuo 恭佐; he is married to a woman née Gao 高氏. He placed 87th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 238th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Li Dakuan; his grandfather is Li Qian; his father is Li Yuanyou; and his mother is née Liu. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brothers are Li Gang and Li Rong, and his younger brother is Li Zhi. He is married to née Yang. He ranked 43rd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 49th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Nai 周鼐 (registered in a civilian household of Guixi County, Guangxin Prefecture, Jiangxi; an expectant student of the prefectural school, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zongyong, second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-three, born on the seventh day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Weizheng; his grandfather was Zhou Xujian (Right Administration Vice Commissioner of Zhejiang); his father was Zhou Fu; his paternal uncles are Zhou Qi (Assistant Prefect) and Zhou You (Assistant Instructor); his father's first wife was née Wu; and his mother is née Jiang. His mother is living. His elder brother is Zhou Ding, and his younger brothers are Zhou Zi, Zhou Mi, Zhou Zi [?], and Zhou Pi. He is married to née Zhang. He ranked 96th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 232nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jin Chun 金純 (registered in a military household of the Yingzhou Central Tun Guard under the Daning Regional Military Commission; a military student of the Pinggu County School in Shuntian Prefecture, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Wenming, second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-second day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Jin Zirong; his grandfather was Jin Tingyu; his father is Jin Kai; his mother is née Qin; and his father's concubine is née Liu. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Jin Shou (Tribute Student [gongshi]), and his younger brothers are Jin Jin, Jin Shen, and Jin Wen. He is married to née Jing. He ranked 195th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 269th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jin Li 金禮 (registered in a military household of Xiushui County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a prefectural school student, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Jingzhi, third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the twentieth day of the intercalary seventh month). His great-grandfather was Jin Shou; his grandfather was Jin Yu; his father is Jin Jian; and his mother is née Wu. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Jin Zongren, Jin Zongyi, Jin Zongzhi, and Jin Zongxin. He is married to née Zheng. He ranked 77th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 222nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

夏時〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《禮記》，字孟寅，行四，年二十六，二月二十五日生〕。曾祖季庄；祖良弼；父尚恭；母黃氏。重慶下，兄毅，弟顯、常。娶周氏。浙江鄉試第九十三名，會試第一百二十六名。
translation_en:
Sun Hong 孫洪 (registered in a military household in Changyi County, Laizhou Prefecture, Shandong; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Boda; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Sun Sigong (posthumously honoured as Director in the Ministry of Rites), his grandfather was Sun Shu (Director in the Ministry of Rites), his father is Sun Xiang, his mother was née Wang, and his stepmother is née Liu. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Sun Han, Sun Pu, Sun Chun, Sun Yuan, Sun Ze, Sun Run, and Sun Zi, and he is married to née Li. He ranked 44th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 311th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fang Gen 方輄 (registered in a civilian household in She County, Huizhou Prefecture, Zhili; Added Student of the prefectural school; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Wenyu; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty, born on the fifteenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Fang Hongyuan, his grandfather was Fang Yongjin (posthumously honoured as Assistant Surveillance Commissioner of Huguang), his father is Fang Mian (Right Assistant Administration Commissioner of Huguang), his father's former wife was née Wang (posthumously honoured as Lady of Suitability), and his mother is née Wang (invested as Lady of Suitability). Both parents are living; his elder brother is Fang Xu, his younger brothers are Fang Zao and Fang Xian, and he is married to née Wu. He ranked 2nd in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 159th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Cong 王聰 (registered in a military household in Sanhe County, Tongzhou, Shuntian Prefecture; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Yanwen; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-fifth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Wang Daiheng, his grandfather was Wang Siqi, his father was Wang Weishan, and his mother is née Li. His mother is living; his younger brothers are Wang Jian and Wang Jie, and he is married to née Liu. He ranked 100th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 269th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xia Shi 夏時 (registered in a civilian household in Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Added Student of the county school; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Mengyin; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-fifth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Xia Jizhuang, his grandfather is Xia Liangbi, his father is Xia Shanggong, and his mother is née Huang. Both grandparents and parents are living; his elder brother is Xia Yi, his younger brothers are Xia Xian and Xia Chang, and he is married to née Zhou. He ranked 93rd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 126th in the Metropolitan Examination.
